400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes. Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl. Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes. Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer. Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a young boy and his mother were kidnapped and murdered by a vicious drug cartel, FBI agents in the field worked tirelessly to pierce the secretive drug underworld and unearth those involved. Their surveillance and investigative work uncovered a violent trail of murder and greed. FBI agents and forensic examiners pieced together the evidence needed to draw out and then crush the cartel.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town. They turned to the FBI labs. The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim. Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move. Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A serial killer's rampage was discovered when the bodies of several young women began turning up in shallow graves that dotted the Alaskan wilderness. The killer taunted his victims, hunting them like animals before shooting them down. He was at home in the rugged terrain. But the hunt for him began 3000 miles away, where FBI profilers mapped the criminal's mind.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a judge and his politician wife were brutally murdered in their home. The killer left few clues and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI was patiently waiting in the wings. Once it was determined that federal laws had been violated, they pounced on the investigation. They uncovered a corrupt local government and a group of violent criminal conspirators known as the Dixie Mafia, responsible for fraud, money laundering and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Residents of the small town of Noel, Missouri were shocked when one of their banks was robbed. When the bank president was nowhere to be found, the residents were outraged. The FBI discovered that things are not always as they appear. Minute clues led the agents to the body of the bank president. With no suspects, the FBI relied on dogged determination and modern forensics. Agents slowly pieced together tiny shreds of evidence.

400000091.title: The FBI Files

The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple. Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off. The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 Midlands - A Celestial Projector Is Brought Back to Life Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Finish Line
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E24 Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S31 E3 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Shetland
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S11 E3 The detectives identify a new suspect with an old grudge against Linden. Emily comes face to face with danger when she confronts her cousin Peter, warning him to stay away from the family - but Peter isn't ready to let sleeping dogs lie. Calder unpicks Graeme's alibi and hauls him over the coals, and the team look at Paddy Rose, who believes Linden euthanised his terminally ill father.

bloomberg.us.description: On Nov. 26, 2025, Hong Kong firefighters were called to Wang Fuk Court, a complex of eight 31-story residential towers; what followed was the city's deadliest fire in almost eight decades that claimed 168 lives and triggered a year of recriminations over who was at fault; examining the ignored warnings and missed opportunities that preceded this disaster, one that continues to impact the families of the dead and the fire's survivors to this day. bloombergtv.au.title: Insight With Haslinda Amin
bloombergtv.au.description: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

bloombergtv.au.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua

cbsphiladelphia.us.title: Let's Make a Deal
cbsphiladelphia.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves.

cinemax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition.

cinemax.us.title: Enemy
cinemax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.

cinemax.us.title: Game Night
cinemax.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

cinemax.us.title: Solace
cinemax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

cinemax.us.title: Buffaloed
cinemax.us.description: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector.

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

cinemax.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemax.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. (movie) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: I Love You Forever
cinemax.us.description: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship. (movie) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Rover
cinemax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (movie) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (movie) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemax.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait. (movie) - 2019

cinemaxaction.us.title: Tomb Raider
cinemaxaction.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Alto Knights
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Aniara
cinemaxaction.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Collision Course
cinemaxaction.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Epic
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxaction.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (movie) - 2023

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hitcher
cinemaxaction.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (movie) - 1986

cinemaxaction.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxaction.us.title: Holla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (movie) - 2006

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Time Bandits
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Working Girls
cinemaxclassics.us.description: College graduate Molly (Louise Smith), trying to bankroll her own business, works as a high-priced New York City escort. As a lesbian, she's able to keep her emotional distance from the clients, who range from cynically exploitative to desperately needy. But her open ambition to rise above her current station rubs many of her coworkers the wrong way, especially the combative, street-smart Dawn (Amanda Goodwin) and the escort service's disdainful madam, Lucy (Ellen McElduff).

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (movie) - 2001

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (movie) - 2004

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (movie) - 2007

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (movie) - 1995

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (movie) - 1998

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
cinemaxclassics.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (movie) - 2002

cinemaxhits.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
cinemaxhits.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Mojave
cinemaxhits.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Arctic
cinemaxhits.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Head Office
cinemaxhits.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
cinemaxhits.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Brian Banks
cinemaxhits.us.description: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: Hoot
cinemaxhits.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (movie) - 2006

cinemaxhits.us.title: Isle of Dogs
cinemaxhits.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
cinemaxhits.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Switch
cinemaxhits.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxhits.us.title: Mid90s
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxhits.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Us
cinemaxwest.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

cinemaxwest.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemaxwest.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxwest.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Enemy
cinemaxwest.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxwest.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Solace
cinemaxwest.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Buffaloed
cinemaxwest.us.description: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector. (movie) - 2019

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemaxwest.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (movie) - 2019

cinemaxwest.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemaxwest.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: I Love You Forever
cinemaxwest.us.description: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Rover
cinemaxwest.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (movie) - 2014

cinesony.us.title: Infinitely Polar Bear
cinesony.us.description: En Boston, un individuo bipolar se hace cargo de la responsabilidad exclusiva de sus dos alegres hijas mientras su esposa asiste a una escuela de posgrado en Nueva York.

cinesony.us.title: Grandma
cinesony.us.description: Una poeta de mal temperamento intenta ayudar a su nieta a ganar los 600 dólares que necesita para un aborto.

cinesony.us.title: Hello, My Name Is Doris
cinesony.us.description: Un seminario de autoayuda inspira a Doris, una mujer sexagenaria, para perseguir románticamente a su joven y nuevo compañero de trabajo.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Jerry Maguire
cinesony.us.description: Jerry Maguire, agente deportivo, pierde su empleo y debe reinventar su carrera profesional con solo dos aliados: un futbolista de segunda categoría y una secretaria, madre soltera.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Sense and Sensibility
cinesony.us.description: Dos hermanas enfrentan sus problemas románticos en la Inglaterra del siglo XIX donde reinan el dinero y la sociedad.

cinevault.us.title: Battle: Los Angeles
cinevault.us.description: For many years, humans have reported various UFO sightings around the world, fueling speculation about the existence of life on other worlds. In 2011, mankind learns the truth the hard way when alien invaders attack. One by one, the world's great cities fall, leaving Los Angeles as the battleground for humanity's last stand. It's up to a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon to draw a line in the sand against a powerful enemy unlike any previously encountered.

cinevault.us.title: Hardwired
cinevault.us.description: After surviving a car crash that kills his pregnant wife, Luke Gibson (Cuba Gooding Jr.) wakes up in the hospital with complete amnesia. He's been severely injured, but is alive thanks to a groundbreaking brain implant from a powerful multinational corporation. As Luke recovers, he starts to realize his implant is dangerous and seeks help from Hal (Michael Ironside), the leader of a group of hackers. A shadowy executive (Val Kilmer) tries to stop Luke and Hal before they learn too much.

cinevault.us.title: Air
cinevault.us.description: When breathable air becomes nonexistent, two engineers (Norman Reedus, Djimon Hounsou) must guard the remaining survivors who reside in a controlled state of suspended animation.

cinevault.us.title: Bermuda Triangle
cinevault.us.description: A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle.

cinevault.us.title: Facing the Giants
cinevault.us.description: Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - The Clampetts in Court
circlecountry.us.description: Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious auto accident.

circlecountry.us.title: Opry Live
circlecountry.us.description: Performances from Opry members Darius Rucker, 49 Winchester and Ashley Cooke.

circlecountry.us.title: Ramblin' Man
circlecountry.us.description: Two Montana cowboys (Jerry Reed, Tom Selleck) head for Nashville and help a woman (Morgan Fairchild) find her sister.

circlecountry.us.title: Coward of the County
circlecountry.us.description: A small-town Southern preacher's (Kenny Rogers) pacifist nephew (Fredric Lehne) is taunted for refusing to enter World War II.

circlecountry.us.title: Django
circlecountry.us.description: Stranger Django (Franco Nero) rides into the middle of a border fray between Mexican bandits and the Ku Klux Klan.

circlecountry.us.title: Minnesota Clay
circlecountry.us.description: A gunfighter (Cameron Mitchell) who is going blind escapes from prison for a showdown with an enemy (Georges Rivière) he can only hear.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Kate and the Manpower Problem
circlecountry.us.description: An old friend of Kate tells the girls to dig up some eligible prospects, in order to get Kate married again.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Ladybugs
circlecountry.us.description: Uncle Joe wants to cash in on the recent Beatlemania fever, by making up a girl group named The Ladybugs, starring his nieces and Sheriff Ragsdale's daughter.

circlecountry.us.title: Circle Shorts
circlecountry.us.description: A bite-sized taste of country lifestyle, Southern travel, artist interviews and down-home food.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - San Francisco
circlecountry.us.description: Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
classica.us.description: Der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die Davidsbündlertänze Op. 6. Sie sind eine Gruppe von achtzehn Klavierstücken, die im Jahr 1837 komponiert wurden. Sie sind nach Schumanns Musikgesellschaft, den Davidsbündlern, benannt.

classica.us.title: Streichquartett Nr. 7 & 13 und Große Fuge
classica.us.description: Das Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène hat anlässlich des 250. Geburtstages von Ludwig van Beethoven alle 16 Streichquartette des Komponisten aufgenommen. In dieser Sendung spielt Quatuor Ébène Beethovens Streichquartett Nr. 7 in F-Dur, Op. 133.

classica.us.title: Tschaikowsky - Lenskis Arie aus Eugen Onegin
classica.us.description: Verschiedene Stars der klassischen Musik nehmen am Benefizkonzert zugunsten des Erasmus-Fonds für "Intensivmed. Forschung" teil. Das Konzert wurde im Königlichen Konservatorium von Brüssel in Belgien am 21. Oktober 2023 aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Zubin Mehta
classica.us.description: Der indische Dirigent Zubin Mehta wurde 1977 Musikdirektor des Israel Philharmonic Orchestra und 1981 zum Musikdirektor auf Lebenszeit ernannt. Als einer der weltweit führenden Interpreten der großen symphonischen Literatur hat Mehta dieses beliebte Meisterwerk unzählige Male dirigiert, aber es war das erste Mal, dass er es von Grund auf einstudiert hat. Ein intimer Blick wird auf den Dialog zwischen Mehta und den Mitgliedern des Orchesters geworfen, während sie Strauss' Tondichtung proben.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
classica.us.description: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik.

classica.us.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Halbfinale I: Anthony Ratinov
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Anthony Ratinov spielt im zweiten Halbfinale des Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 den ersten Satz des Klavierquartetts, op. 47 von Robert Schumann. Er wird von den Hauptstreichern des Montreal Symphonieorchesters begleitet.

classica.us.title: Beethoven: Sinfonie Nr. 3 in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Gianandrea Noseda leitet das Orchester des Teatro alla Scala in Mailand. Auf dem Spielprogramm stehen Ludwig van Beethoven, Symphonie Nr. 3 Es-Dur op. 55.

classica.us.title: Klavierwerke von Rachmaninoff, Beethoven, Glazunov
classica.us.description: Der russische Pianist Nikolay Lugansky wird weltweit für seine Interpretationen von Sergei Rachmaninow gelobt. In diesem wunderbaren Rezital präsentiert der großartige Pianist eine Auswahl an Werken des russischen Romantik-Komponisten.

classica.us.title: Bach - Goldberg-Variationen, BWV 988
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti spielt 2015 im Theater Carlo Felice in Genua Bachs Goldberg-Variationen, BWV 988. Das Werk ist nach dem Cembalisten Johann Gottlieb Goldberg benannt, der möglicherweise der erste Interpret des Werkes war.

classica.us.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
classica.us.description: Die Musikerin Barbara Hannigan gewann den Grammy für das beste klassische Solo-Vokalalbum 2018 und wurde 2022 als Künstlerin des Jahres ausgezeichnet. Im Herbst 2023 gab sie ihr lang erwartetes Dirigentendebüt mit dem Cleveland Orchestra.

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 2
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte.

classica.us.title: La Bayadère
classica.us.description: La Bayadère ist ein Ballett in drei Akten des französischen Choreografen Marius Petipa. Es spielt im Indien des 19. Jahrhunderts und erzählt die traurige Liebesgeschichte des edlen Kriegers Solor und der Tempeltänzerin Nikia.

classica.us.title: Werke von Gluck, Bach und Mozart
classica.us.description: Der in Venezuela geborene Dirigent Giovanni Guzzo leitet durch dieses 2024 in Madrid aufgezeichnete Konzert. Es standen Werke von Christoph Willibald Gluck, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Johann Sebastian Bach auf dem Programm.

classica.us.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 36 'Linz'
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester in einem Konzert, in dem ein bezauberndes Werk von Mozart aufgeführt wird, das eine emotionale Verbindung zum Dirigenten hat: Die Symphonie Nr. 36 'Linz' ist nach der Heimatstadt von Welser-Möst.

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet.

classica.us.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 34, K. 338
classica.us.description: Der Maestro Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem fesselnden Konzertprogramm mit Werken von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Antonín Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt.

classica.us.title: Werke von Bach, Bartók und Brahms
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer führt sein Budapest Festival Orchester mit Werken von Johann Sebastian Bach, Béla Bartók und Johannes Brahms. Die Aufführung wurde am 4. Dezember 2017 in der Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Chopin - Polonaise-Fantasie, op. 61
classica.us.description: Die in der Ukraine geborene Pianistin Inna Faliks spielt Frederic Chopins Polonaise-Fantasie Op. 61. Aufgenommen in der Nicols Konzert Hall in Evanston. Faliks hat sich als eine der poetischsten Künstlerinnen ihrer Generation etabliert.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Frozen Assets Episode
cleotv.us.description: Dee Dee's life changes direction when she gets an unexpected career opportunity.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Moving On Out
cleotv.us.description: When Kim moves in with Stevie, their tipsy mothers crash their first party; T woos Kim's building superintendent.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Unforgiven
cleotv.us.description: Nikki's parents arrive in town to renew their wedding vows, but an age-old grudge threatens the ceremony.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - It's a Spring Bling Thing
cleotv.us.description: Kim and her band are booked to perform in Palm Springs, Calif., during spring break; Nikki abducts professor Oglevee.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Get Me to the Church on Time
cleotv.us.description: Nikki and professor Oglevee (Mo'Nique, Dorien Wilson) race to Las Vegas to stop Kim's (Countess Vaughn) impulsive marriage.

cleotv.us.title: Living by Design - TCara & Zack
cleotv.us.description: Jake and Jazz revamp TCara and Zacks' bedroom into a serene retreat; Jake adds textured wall panels and custom shelving for depth; Jazz completes the transformation with soft colors, elegant curtains and stylish furniture to create the perfect space.

cleotv.us.title: Living by Design - Ashley & Kevin
cleotv.us.description: Ashley and Kevin call Jake and Jazz to transform their living room into an entertainer's dream; Jake handcrafts a unique, custom coffee table; and Jazz creates cozy, natural aesthetics, creating the perfect inviting space for hosting family and friends.

cleotv.us.title: New Soul Kitchen - Childhood Memories
cleotv.us.description: From breakfast, lunch, and dinner to parties and holiday gatherings, everyone has a favorite childhood memory when it comes to food; Chef Jernard and Chef Essie Bartels take a trip down memory lane and share some of their childhood food memories.

cleotv.us.title: New Soul Kitchen - Hearty, Healthy and Vegan
cleotv.us.description: What's better than a vegan meal? A meal that's "Hearty, Healthy and Vegan"; Chef Jernard invites the vegan go-to-girl Chef Ahki Taylor, over for some fun in the kitchen and a good meatless meal; Jernard prepares Smoky Black Bean Mushroom and Bee.

cleotv.us.title: Culture Kitchen - Cuban and Jamaican Street Food
cleotv.us.description: On this episode, Bren shares some of her favorite street foods from Cuba and Jamaica. First, she cooks up her version of jerk chicken patties, and then it's Papa Rellena, a stuffed potato done Cuban style.

cleotv.us.title: Culture Kitchen - Celebrating My Mother & Grandmother
cleotv.us.description: Bren makes some of her favorite foods that pay homage to her mother and grandmother. She lays out a Chickpea & Tripe Stew and then sweetens things up with a salted caramel & espresso flan.

cleotv.us.title: Living by Design - Stacy & Alain
cleotv.us.description: Stacy and the family want the ultimate family room; Jake builds a large chalkboard while Jazz finds jumbo games that double as decorations; for the reveal, Jake makes Caribbean and Mexican Chicken Enchiladas; Jazz bakes off Chunky Monster Cookies.

cleotv.us.title: Living by Design - Aria Christian
cleotv.us.description: Jake and Jazz merge fashion and function for Aria and her impressive book collection. Jake makes a custom bookshelf, and Jazz brings in new lighting and accent pieces. On the menu is Jake's Fettuccine with Crab Cake Bake and Jazz makes Kiwi Lime pie.

cleotv.us.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Seafood All Day
cleotv.us.description: It's all about seafood, with baked salmon, sautéed spinach and a shrimp Alfredo sauce. Topped off with a seafood salad with shrimp & jumbo lump crab.

cleotv.us.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Blue Plate Special
cleotv.us.description: Tamar & Ms. E make a family favorite. Chicken a la King made with sautéed chicken thighs, carrots & peas in a cream sauce, served over toast.

cleotv.us.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Family Favorites
cleotv.us.description: Tamar turns the kitchen over to Ms. E and her son Logan to prepare Logan's favorite meal; they make Salisbury steak, rice, and gravy with broccoli.

cleotv.us.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Family Dinners
cleotv.us.description: Tamar and Ms. E hit the kitchen to whip up a mouthwatering family dinner from scratch. On the menu: sticky, slow-cooked BBQ ribs, creamy mashed sweet potatoes and savory Brussels sprouts tossed with crispy bacon.

cleotv.us.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Braxton Favorites
cleotv.us.description: Tamar and Ms. E are serving up the ultimate Braxton favorites in a spectacular, flavor-packed episode. The headliner is a massive, seasoned seafood boil and for dessert, a banana pudding with a chocolate twist.

cleotv.us.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Holiday Cooking Favorites
cleotv.us.description: Tamar and Ms. E serve up some cozy Braxton holiday favorites in this episode. The kitchen is filled with comfort and joy as they simmer a rich, savory, tender beef stew and roll up classic, flavorful stuffed cabbage.

cleotv.us.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Family Favorites
cleotv.us.description: Chef JJ's family favorites are front in center; he starts out with a fried catfish sandwich that's golden brown served with another favorite, fried plantains.

cleotv.us.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - JJ's Family Sunday Dinner
cleotv.us.description: JJ brings out the best for Sunday dinner! He cooks up slow cooked braised short ribs in a creamy gravy served with garlic mashed potatoes, and grilled asparagus. For dessert, it's a mixed berry compote over ice cream.

cleotv.us.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Kicked Up Turkey
cleotv.us.description: Stylist/designer Ashlee Muhammad stops by, and Chef JJ makes her a kicked up turkey dinner, first it's a mixed berry rosemary rum smash, then it's braised turkey wings smothered in gravy and cabbage on the side.

cleotv.us.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Potluck With JJ
cleotv.us.description: Chef JJ teams up with actress Katelyn Bennett for the ultimate potluck meal guaranteed to impress any crowd; they start with tender, smothered turkey wings drenched in savory gravy, served with truffle mashed potatoes.

cleotv.us.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Dinner Party Vibes
cleotv.us.description: Chef JJ invites fellow Chef Jeff into his kitchen for a bold, flavor-packed meal centered around Caribbean warmth. He makes a spicy slow-cooked curried goat meal w/ vegetable in gravy. He tops the meal off with a creamy, refreshing coconut margarita.

cleotv.us.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Let Him Cook /No Rules
cleotv.us.description: Chef JJ welcomes his good friend Sade Muhammad into his kitchen and makes a meal that is full of flavor. On the menu is curry chicken stew served with a side of garlicky sautéed kale. The experience is rounded out with an apple cider punch mocktail.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Wedding Bell Blues
cleotv.us.description: Nikki and professor Oglevee share a honeymoon suite after abandoning their fruitless search for Kim and Jerel.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Breaking Up Is Hard to Do
cleotv.us.description: Newlyweds Kim and Jerel make plans to move to Paris; professor Oglevee goes to great lengths to make Veronica jealous.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Reunited
cleotv.us.description: While a quarreling Nikki and Kim try to live together, the two must band together to foil a robbery attempt.

cmt.us.title: The Golden Girls - Sick and Tired: Part 1
cmt.us.description: Dorothy consults medical experts about her chronic fatigue, which raises concern in Rose and Sophia.

cmt.us.title: The Golden Girls - Sick and Tired: Part 2
cmt.us.description: Harry Weston recommends a specialist who diagnoses Dorothy's illness.

cmt.us.title: The Golden Girls - Accurate Conception
cmt.us.description: Blanche's unmarried daughter announces her desire to have a baby.

cmt.us.title: The Golden Girls
cmt.us.description: Four mature women live together in Miami and experience the joys and angst of their golden years; strong-willed Dorothy, spacey Rose, lusty Southern belle Blanche and matriarch Sophia, Dorothy's mom, occasionally clash but are there for one another in the end; after all, when the show's theme song is titled "Thank You for Being a Friend," the ladies have to remain friendly with one another.

cmt.us.title: Mama's Family
cmt.us.description: Thelma "Mama" Harper is the quick-tempered, blue-haired matriarch of the Harper family who lives with son Vint and his wife, Naomi, who were forced to move into Mama's basement after losing money in a business deal gone awry. After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. Vicki Lawrence stars as Mama, a character she originated in sketches on "The Carol Burnett Show." (Sitcom) - 1983-01-22

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 The Battle of the Beaches In June 1944, the Allies landed in Normandy, beginning a momentous struggle against Nazi occupation that would take almost 100 days to break the German resistance in a military operation unrivalled in history.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 The Blaze: 1939 - 1941 Germany's invasion of Poland sparks global war; Blitzkrieg crushes France and Britain stands alone; Japan expands across Asia, exploiting colonial weakness; in China, resistance grinds on; Africa becomes a new front.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Total War: 1941 - 1942 Hitler invades the Soviet Union, but Moscow holds; Japan bombs Pearl Harbor, drawing the U.S. into war; global conflict escalates as genocide and total destruction define the Axis war machine.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 The Tide Turns: 1943 - 1944 Stalingrad breaks the Nazi advance; Japan falters at Guadalcanal. The tide begins to turn. Mussolini falls as Allies land in Sicily. The Soviets crush Germany at Kursk. Allied tech improves: radar, codebreaking, bombing raids.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Restructuring the World: 1944 - 1945 D-Day lands Allied troops in Normandy; in the East, Operation Bagration devastates Germany; Paris is freed; Stalin secures Eastern Europe; in 1945, Berlin falls and Hitler dies; Germany surrenders.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II Archives

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back

But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mysteria

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway

foodnetwork.us.description: Host Josh Peck welcomes three Christmas carolers to a historic holiday tavern, where they hunt for six hyperrealistic cakes created by baker April Julian and disguised as everyday objects; can the singing trio end on a high note and win up to $12,000?

foodnetwork.us.title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars - Finale

foodnetwork.us.description: Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Wars - A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree
foodnetwork.us.description: Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

The story revolves around sub-zero heroes: a woolly mammoth, a saber-toothed tiger, a sloth and a prehistoric combination of a squirrel and rat that is known as Scrat.

grit.us.title: Fort Worth
grit.us.description: Reformed gunman Ned Britt (Randolph Scott) travels to Fort Worth, Texas, to take over the abandoned newspaper. Crooked trail boss Gabe Clevenger (Ray Teal), a former antagonist of Ned's, challenges him on the trail. Ned refuses to fight, which disappoints fellow passenger Flora Talbot (Phyllis Thaxter), who had taken a liking to him but now sees him as weak. In Fort Worth, Ned discovers Clevenger is battling the burgeoning railroad and decides to fight back using the power of the press.

grit.us.title: Trail Street
grit.us.description: Legendary lawman Bat Masterson (Randolph Scott) is called to rural Kansas to defend farmers from ruthless cattlemen. Joining Masterson in his efforts to clean up a lawless town are a couple of locals: Masterson's old chum Billy Burn and landowner Allen Harper (Robert Ryan). But ranch owner Logan Maury proves to be a more than formidable opponent. He'll stop at nothing, including murder, to turn the farmers' fields into grazing grounds for his cattle.

grit.us.title: The Man Behind the Gun
grit.us.description: An Army major goes undercover to stop a dangerous plot to make Southern California a separate state, facing immense personal risk and complex challenges.

grit.us.title: Buchanan Rides Alone
grit.us.description: Journeying from Mexico back home to West Texas, mercenary Tom Buchanan takes a break for the night in the border town of Agry. He soon discovers that almost every resident -- from the crooked sheriff to the shifty-eyed innkeeper -- is a member of the prominent Agry family. When Buchanan defends Juan de la Vega, a young man about to be lynched for shooting the town drunk, he himself is accused of murder and must struggle to escape town alive.

grit.us.title: Thunder Over the Plains
grit.us.description: It's the late 1860s, and the U.S. government has yet to reclaim Texas as a state. A group of opportunistic and amoral Northerners head south to claim the territory as their own. Though Texas lawman Capt. Porter (Randolph Scott) believes it's his duty to honor the local leaders, he can't ignore the corruption of the Yankee politicians who are giving him orders. When Confederate veteran Ben (Charles McGraw) is unjustly sentenced to death, Porter decides he has had enough of his new bosses. (movie) - 1953

grit.us.title: Carson City
grit.us.description: After one too many successful stick-ups of the Carson City stagecoach by the Champagne Bandits, the local banker decides to build a railroad track through town. To do so, he'll need to employ the help of "Silent" Jeff Kincaid (Randolph Scott), the only man who can tunnel through the mountainous region. Unfortunately, Kincaid has more than just the mountains to deal with -- neither the locals nor the Champagne Bandits are happy about the new railway. (movie) - 1952

grit.us.title: The Bounty Hunter
grit.us.description: Jim Kipp (Randolph Scott) is a bounty hunter hired to find three robbers who committed a daring heist three years ago. When he arrives in a small town near the robbery, he senses that the thieves may be living there. However, many of the townspeople -- including Dr. Spencer (Harry Antrim), his daughter, Julie (Dolores Dorn), and barmaid Alice (Marie Windsor) -- are put on edge by Kipp's presence and want him gone. Kipp perseveres, hatching a plan that he thinks will draw out the bandits. (movie) - 1954

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Anything for a Buck
history.ca.description: When earning a paycheck meant risking life and limb; from dangling off skyscrapers without safety harnesses and riding runaway logs down raging rivers, to digging up corpses for cash and selling your own blood to scrape by, people once took unbelievable risks no paycheck could truly cover; whether racing pizzas across town at breakneck speed or pulling off death-defying Hollywood stunts, people once did whatever it took to earn a living.

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Harrowing Highways
history.ca.description: Remember when hitting the road promised freedom, adventure… and a few risky surprises? From marathon cross-country races that pushed drivers to the limit, to flaming roadside smudge pots that lined the way after dark, to endless stretches of highway that lulled motorists into dangerous trances, America's love affair with the open road was full of unexpected twists and turns; these are the engineering feats and automotive innovations that transformed the journey.

kcnc.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
kcnc.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

kdka.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. koco.us.description: Before the age of 30, journalist and Emmy-winner Graham Bensinger worked not only for major networks like NBC and ESPN, but he also began his own syndicated interview program that airs weekly across the country. Bensinger chats with some of sports' biggest names, including pro football players Terrell Owens and Tony Romo, professional basketball player Kobe Bryant, boxing champion George Foreman and broadcaster Joe Buck. Exposing corruption across the United States is the goal of the series. Cases featured in the half-hour episodes include an ATM heist that resulted in nearly $45 million being stolen worldwide and the former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick.

kolndt.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
kolndt.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

krex.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
krex.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

krtv.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
krtv.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Cabin for the Bride
magnolianetwork.us.description: While getting ready for Lance's wedding in Augusta, Maine, Chase gets a call from a friend who has a log cabin stuck in her backyard; Chase sees the cabin as a fun project for the team to work on and to present to Lance's bride.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Peace, Love and a Fallen Pine Tree
magnolianetwork.us.description: A winter storm and a fallen tree jeopardize to destroy a family's Bear Pond property; Chase and the Cabin Masters come to the rescue, preserving the camp's oddities and adding space for the soon-arriving next generation.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - City Slickers Off the Grid
magnolianetwork.us.description: Chase and his team renovate an off-the-grid camp for a family of city slickers; with limited resources, the team members work to incorporate the comforts of city living, then they discover a moldering water tank that may shut down the renovation.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Cabin for the Bride
magnolianetwork.us.description: While getting ready for Lance's wedding in Augusta, Maine, Chase gets a call from a friend who has a log cabin stuck in her backyard; Chase sees the cabin as a fun project for the team to work on and to present to Lance's bride.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Family Cabin Reclaimed
magnolianetwork.us.description: A family that has owned land in Maine for over 100 years repurchases land they previously sold and calls on the Cabin Masters to refurbish an abandoned property; the team creates a new bathroom, bedroom and yoga space and add landscaping outside.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Noland Sign Company
magnolianetwork.us.description: The Black Dog Salvage team works at the Noland Sign Company in Roanoke, Va.; on a windy day, the crew salvages metal lettering, copper cupolas and vintage plumbing; Grayson buys an initial machine for the shop.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - St. Agatha's Church Rectory
magnolianetwork.us.description: The team heads back to snowy Ellwood City, Pa., to salvage the rectory of St. Agatha's Catholic Church; they take a tour of the Bally Block Factory where Robert's grandfather used to work.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Trinity Lutheran Church
magnolianetwork.us.description: In Greencastle, Pa., the crew salvages an old church that is being restored and turned into a physical therapy office; the team struggles to figure out the best way to remove the windows, salvage the large bell and execute an idea for a console.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Esther Ludwig Mansion
magnolianetwork.us.description: The crew travels to Pennsylvania to save what it can from Esther Ludwig's mansion before it gets demolished, hoping to reclaim some of the mansion's original items, such as chandeliers, built-ins and mantles; Mike buys an old vintage wheelchair.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Barnwood Builders - The Johnny Jett Special
magnolianetwork.us.description: The Barnwood Builders honor machinist, artist and craftsman Johnny Jett; a highlight of Johnny's most unforgettable moments as well as previously unaired footage featuring West Virginia's favorite Renaissance man.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Revamping the Cook's Beach Camp
magnolianetwork.us.description: The Cabin Masters tackle a cabin and bunkhouse that have been rotting for 30 years on Cook's Beach; With a 12-week timeline and a $50,000 budget for both structures, the team must design on a dime to transform the property by the deadline.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Golden Years Family Camp
magnolianetwork.us.description: After buying her parents' old summer camp, a mother calls on the Cabin Masters to help her renovate the home for her parents to retire in full-time; with a $40,000 budget and open timeline, Chase and his crew come in to transform this camp.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Lobster Shack Scramble
magnolianetwork.us.description: For Ted Wiederhorn, a cabin on the ocean front was a dream he always had; with his wish granted after purchasing an abandoned lobster shack on a peninsula, it's up to the Cabin Masters to get this shack running again.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Stable Family Ties
magnolianetwork.us.description: Chase and the crew seek to turn a vacation cabin that was originally a 1920s horse barn into a stable building for a large family; drawing from the past, the crew wants to honor the owners' late parents in this emotional build.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - New Wife, New Cabin Life
magnolianetwork.us.description: Two newlyweds call on the Cabin Masters to expand the 1957 Great Pond cabin they inherited to include enough space for their family, which includes three children, their spouses and six grandchildren.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Hook, Line and Sinker
magnolianetwork.us.description: A couple buys a dilapidated cabin in Phillips, Maine, in hopes of keeping the area's fly-fishing traditions alive; Chase Morrill and his team pull out all the stops to fix a myriad of issues in just 11 weeks.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Cabin for the Whole Family
magnolianetwork.us.description: It is a great opportunity for Chase and the team to rebuild and ultimately repair a cabin for a man and his family, but they will have to act quickly so they can finish before winter arrives so that the family can enjoy it for years to come.

mavtv.ca.title: À l'heure du développement durable S01 E03

mavtv.ca.title: Quand les jeunes prennent la parole S01 E02

mgmplus.us.title: The Silence of the Lambs
mgmplus.us.description: Jodie Foster stars as Clarice Starling, a top student at the FBI's training academy. Jack Crawford (Scott Glenn) wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins), a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism. Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.

mgmplus.us.title: Hannibal
mgmplus.us.description: Seven years have passed since Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) escaped from custody. The doctor is now at large in Europe. Mason Verger (Gary Oldman) remembers Lecter too, and is obsessed with revenge. Verger was Dr. Lecter's sixth victim, and though horribly disfigured, has survived. Verger realizes that to draw the doctor into the open, he must use someone as bait: Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore).

mgmplus.us.title: Secret Service
mgmplus.us.description: MI6 agent Kate Henderson uncovers an audacious plot involving Russia and an asset in the UK Cabinet; Kate's hunt for the mole puts her agent's life at risk.

mgmplus.us.title: The Institute - Double Cross
mgmplus.us.description: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

mgmplus.us.title: Unprotected Sets - Lynne Koplitz
mgmplus.us.description: Lynne Koplitz radiates on and offstage with her sarcastic wit turning a plethora of topics including dieting, menopause, chivalry and life as the daughter of a New Jersey mobster into huge laughs.

mgmplus.us.title: Flight of the Intruder
mgmplus.us.description: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed.

mgmplus.us.title: Scrooge
mgmplus.us.description: Ebenezer Scrooge (Albert Finney) is the definition of a miser. He is rich, but completely stingy with his money, and he exploits the good nature of his employee Bob Cratchit (David Collings). On Christmas Eve, however, Scrooge is in store for a rude awakening when he is visited by the ghost of his old business partner, Jacob Marley (Alec Guinness), who informs him that he is going to be visited by three ghosts, including the Ghosts of Christmas Past (Edith Evans) and Present (Kenneth More).

mgmplus.us.title: Home for the Holidays
mgmplus.us.description: When her teenage daughter opts out of Thanksgiving, single mother Claudia Larson (Holly Hunter) travels alone to her childhood home for an explosive holiday dinner with her dysfunctional family. Claudia quickly tires of her parents, her long-suffering sister (Cynthia Stevenson), her snobby brother-in-law (Steve Guttenberg) and her nutty aunt (Geraldine Chaplin). But the evening gets interesting when sparks fly between Claudia and her brother's handsome friend Leo Fish (Dylan McDermott). (movie) - 1995

mgmplus.us.title: The Preacher's Wife
mgmplus.us.description: A cleric begins to doubt himself and is visited by an angel. The heavenly emissary is supposed to help the good reverend over his midlife crisis, but he is distracted by the cleric's lovely young wife. A remake with gospel music of the "The Bishop's Wife". (movie) - 1996

In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

Among the prisoners determined to escape are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett. Outwitting their captors by digging a tunnel out of the prison grounds, the soldiers find the stakes much higher when escape becomes a reality.
