motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Dragoneer Forever!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich bring in Dave Chappelle and Lucky Costa to fully build the Dragoneer, a 1970 Jeep Wagoneer set up as a sleeper drag car; they end up with a 408ci LS making 750 horsepower to the tires that pulls wheelies at the strip!

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Satellite Cop Car Makeover!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich fall in love with their 318ci '71 Satellite, which years ago, they would have only ridden in if they were sporting cuffs, by making it into a cop car clone; see it handle against a new cop car!

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Fresh Pontiac Power in the T-37!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich refresh their junkyard-rescued 1971 Pontiac T-37 by removing the tired Pontiac 400ci V-8; they replace it with fresh Pontiac power that delivers some horsepower.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Dragoneer Forever!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich bring in Dave Chappelle and Lucky Costa to fully build the Dragoneer, a 1970 Jeep Wagoneer set up as a sleeper drag car; they end up with a 408ci LS making 750 horsepower to the tires that pulls wheelies at the strip!

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Complete El Camino Makeover!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich head to Hot Rod Ranch to make the 454 big-block '73 El Camino SS known as the El Cochino a bit less of a pig; a new suspension, a Holley Sniper 2 EFI and a four-hour paint job totally transform it into a desirable ride.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Transforming the Hemi Belvedere!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich forge on with making David's 1969 Plymouth Belvedere drivable; the car has a 426 Hemi, four-speed manual, and a Dana 60 rear end, but still needs a whole lot more.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Muscle Truck Showdown
motortrend.us.description: Dulcich and Chris Birdsong refurbish a rear end and overcome roadblocks before getting the '74 Dodge D100 Mopar Muscle Truck ready to face off with Freiburger and his '74 Chevy Muscle Truck.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal's Loud and Lifted - Defender and Bronco
motortrend.us.description: The 1991 Land Rover Defender is known for ruggedness and simplicity; Mod Mafia does a reboot of a tired, old Defender with modern performance, power and custom luxury; Wide Open Garage takes an old-school Bronco monster truck into overdrive.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal's Loud and Lifted - Hummer H1 King
motortrend.us.description: Social media star Liver King not only wants Mod Mafia to beef up his prized 2001 H1 Hummer's performance, he wants to customize it for his primal lifestyle; the team at Wide Open Garage must build a custom off-road truck completely from scratch.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Stubby Bob Strikes Back!
motortrend.us.description: The guys retry road-tripping Stubby Bob to a dirt drag track in Arizona.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Off-Road Pacer Road Trip!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger surprises David Chappelle with a road trip in an old project: Dirt Every Day's '76 Off-Road Pacer. Not much works in this lifted 4x4 AMC, but that doesn't stop the guys from ignoring problems, tempting fate and pressing on down the road.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Stripped Down at the Dragstrip
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Finnegan pick up a Hemi-powered pickup to cut up and strip down at the dragstrip at MotorTrend's Roadkill Nights powered by Dodge.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Mazdarati 2.0: Project Car Showdown!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Finnegan complete the Mazdarati 2.0 and bring some of "Roadkill's" project cars back to life; they road trip to a multi-car drag-cross showdown.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Camaro Frankenstein
motortrend.us.description: A 1989 Camaro turns out to be anything but what it seems.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Seeing Double
motortrend.us.description: Two workhorse Chevy beasts need a lot of work to get on their feet. (Reality TV, Instructional)

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Phoenix Firebird
motortrend.us.description: A classic Firebird rises from the ashes for the first time in 15 years. (Reality TV, Instructional)

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Military Restoration
motortrend.us.description: A Vietnam-era Jeep gets pressed back into service. (Reality TV, Instructional)

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides: Road to the Ridler - Riddle Me This
motortrend.us.description: Dave and the crew start their all-aluminum Ridler build by creating a fiberglass buck; Dave realizes there may be a problem with the roof. (Reality TV, Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Aluminum, Aluminum and More Aluminum
motortrend.us.description: The fabrication process begins; the team begins to see how difficult building a car out of aluminum by hand will be; each panel needs to be handcrafted to perfection and some of the lines in Dave's drawings look virtually impossible to replicate. (Reality TV, Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Too Late to Turn Back Now
motortrend.us.description: After almost a year of fabrication, the team starts assembling panels into the shape of a car; the chassis is also made of aluminum and after a painstaking frame-design process, the two shapes are melded together for the first and last time. (Reality TV, Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Come Together, Right Now..
motortrend.us.description: The team passes a big milestone in the Ridler build as the body and chassis are merged with mock-ups of the other major elements of the car; for the next step, the body shop matches every panel, gaps the car seamlessly and fixes any flaws. (Reality TV, Automotive)

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - If It Was Easy, Anyone Could Do It
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The metal masters take on a 1967 Chevelle with Great 8 pedigree and high expectations; Dave learns the hard way that builds do not always go according to plan.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - A Family Affair
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The entire Kindig family works hard to convert a '57 Corvette into a bitchin' ride as a retirement gift for Charity's father, but getting the kids motivated to help is easier said than done; a 1967 Malibu's AC is repaired.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - It's Getting Hot in Here
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The shop pulls out all the stops to take home the gold at the last car show of the season; the Fairlane and the Nomad receive extra attention; Dave and Kevin check out the best vehicles in Reno.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Future Is Now
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A '32 roadster is secretly purchased for a client's wife and shipped to Kindig It Design for mechanical upgrades and styling changes; Dave redesigns a 2004 Hummer.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Secret Client
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Dave is tasked with finding and transforming a 1967 Pontiac GTO for a secret client from South Africa; Dave buys back one of his first builds, a Volkswagen Karmann Ghia, but does not know what he will do with it when he gets it back on the road.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - GT...Ohhh Hell Yeah!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Final details on the 1967 Pontiac GTO include tanzanite blue paint, redline wheels and a custom interior; a Chevelle arrives for a small but poignant upgrade.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - We Build Bitchin Rides
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Dave and the team at Kindig It Design start a new year with a one-of-a-kind build they have never attempted before, a 1964 Ranchero; the car looks to have had a lot of work done, but what's underneath the metal sets the team back.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - 24 Karat Magic
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The Ranchero build is an epic achievement for Dave and the whole Kindig It Design team, but they hope the client sees it the same way; Dave seeks the perfect name for the perfect car.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Little Sister
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A Canadian father-daughter team arrives to add a new ride to their impressive collection; building the little sister to the '62 Safari Bus is something close to Dave's VW roots; fresh off the showroom floor, a 2017 Cadillac CTSV.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - A Caldera-What?
motortrendfasttv.us.description: An old build is back for new customizations, an interior revamp and a new name; with Kevin headed out of town, Dave tries to sneak a new and personal project through the doors.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Hummer of the Future
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A new client arrives and asks Dave to envision a future where the Hummer H2 continued to be produced and to build what he thinks that car might look like 20 years into the future; it's out with the old and in with the new, as Kevin leads the charge.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Fiberglass, Fiberglass and More Fiberglass
motortrendfasttv.us.description: One of Dave's all-time favorite designs is the Mercedes Gullwing, and a new client arrives with a kit version of the car; the car kit has many flaws, which the team needs to address while trying to get the car as close as they can to the original.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Snowball Episode
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A '41 Chevy that has bounced around numerous shops rolls in for a quick trunk lid fix, but things go south very quickly; as if the shop wasn't busy enough, they kick off a Road Tour and the garage turns into an ER for broken down cars.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Green for the Money
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Every inch of the Mercedes Gullwing has finally been addressed, and the car comes to an epic conclusion; questions and challenges remain, including which color will be just right and whether the doors will actually function.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Where's the Gold, Paulie?
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Dave and the team swap the chassis in a 1955 Nomad and upgrade its performance, which will give this car the edge it was missing.

movieplex.us.title: Any Last Words?
movieplex.us.description: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life.

movieplex.us.title: Alpha and Omega 2: A Howl-iday Adventure
movieplex.us.description: Two wolves journey across the wilderness to find their smallest cub.

movieplex.us.title: Cricket & Antoinette
movieplex.us.description: Cricket and Antoinette represent two separate worlds, the world of noise, chaos and creativity, and the world of work, order and discipline; as they fall in love, in spite of obvious differences, they manage to create harmony.

movieplex.us.title: Happily N'Ever After 2: Snow White: Another Bite at the Apple
movieplex.us.description: Snow White (Helen Niedwick) must prevent her father from marrying a scheming witch who wants to rule the kingdom.

movieplex.us.title: The Snow Queen 2
movieplex.us.description: After the trolls' victory over the Snow Queen, Orm claims that he is destined to marry the princess and inherit great power.

movieplex.us.title: The Dog Who Saved Summer
movieplex.us.description: After their dog Zeus ruins a party, George takes him to an obedience school run by a no-nonsense instructor. When Zeus manages to fail every test, he seeks help from a trainer with special techniques.

movieplex.us.title: H Is for Happiness
movieplex.us.description: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again.

movieplex.us.title: Children on Their Birthdays
movieplex.us.description: A 13-year-old (Joe Pichler) develops his first crush while his mother begins a romance with a wholesome mechanic.

movieplex.us.title: Oddball
movieplex.us.description: A chicken farmer and his granddaughter train a dog to protect a penguin sanctuary from foxes.

movieplex.us.title: Still Mine
movieplex.us.description: A farmer fights back when local authorities hamper his efforts to build a cottage for his dementia-stricken wife. (movie) - 2012

movieplex.us.title: Miss Virginia
movieplex.us.description: An impoverished single mother is losing her 15-year-old son to the rough streets of Washington, D.C. Unwilling to see him drop out and deal drugs, she places him in a private school. But when she can't afford the tuition, she soon launches a movement to change the system that is destroying him and thousands of others. (movie) - 2019

movieplex.us.title: Starting Out in the Evening
movieplex.us.description: A complex relationship develops between Leonard (Frank Langella), an academic novelist of advancing years, and Heather (Lauren Ambrose), a determined, fresh-faced graduate student doing her master's thesis on Leonard's career. Leonard keeps everyone at an emotional distance, including his devoted daughter, Ariel (Lili Taylor), and her unsettled boyfriend, Casey (Adrian Lester). Heather's attention, although motivated by selfish interests, forces Leonard to reexamine his life. (movie) - 2007

movieplex.us.title: Any Last Words?
movieplex.us.description: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life. (movie) - 2012

movieplex.us.title: The Moon and Back
movieplex.us.description: High school senior Lydia Gilbert feels lost after her father's death, until she discovers a space opera script written by him. Equipped with a VHS camera and pocket change, she decides to honor her dad and make the script a reality. (movie) - 2022

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible III
movies.us.description: Retired from active duty, and training recruits for the Impossible Mission Force, agent Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) faces the toughest foe of his career: Owen Davian (Philip Seymour Hoffman), an international broker of arms and information, who is as cunning as he is ruthless. Davian emerges to threaten Hunt and all that he holds dear -- including the woman Hunt loves.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible -- Ghost Protocol
movies.us.description: Blamed for a terrorist attack on the Kremlin, Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and the entire IMF agency are disavowed by the U.S. government, while the president initiates the Ghost Protocol. Forced to go "off the grid" -- left without resources or backup -- Hunt must somehow clear the agency's name and prevent another attack. Complicating matters even more, Ethan must undertake the impossible mission with a group of fellow IMF fugitives whose actual motives are suspect.

movies.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
movies.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's the Family That Preys
moviesphere.us.description: Despite their differences in social class, Charlotte (Kathy Bates) and Alice (Alfre Woodard) are good friends for many years. Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

moviesphere.us.title: The Single Moms Club
moviesphere.us.description: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

moviesphere.us.title: I Can Do Bad All by Myself
moviesphere.us.description: Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's Meet the Browns
moviesphere.us.description: Single mother Brenda (Angela Bassett) suddenly loses her job, then she receives news that the father she never met is dead. With nothing to lose, she gathers her brood and heads to Georgia, where she meets her father's uproarious family for the first time and finds the tentative beginnings of a new romance.

moviesphere.us.title: Into the Deep
moviesphere.us.description: A woman's whirlwind romance with a handsome stranger soon turns into a web of deceit, mistrust and violence aboard his yacht.

mtv2west.us.title: Final Destination
mtv2west.us.description: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper.

mtv2west.us.title: Final Destination 2
mtv2west.us.description: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway.

mtv2west.us.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark

Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo.

mtv2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

mtv2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E01 Winter in Portlandia It's wintertime in Portlandia and Peter and Nance struggle to keep off winter weight by cutting pasta from their diets; Candace's son visits Women and Women First bookstore for the holidays; a couple tries to keep their food cart in business.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E02 Take Back MTV Spyke and Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens; a group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor; Sandra has a crush on a mysterious man in her meditation class.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E03 Missionaries The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland; pedicab driver hustles for clients; Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E04 Nina's Birthday Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The day-long event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night. The party turns into a Tapas Dinner.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E05 Squiggleman Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music; The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement; Malcom and Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E06 Off the Grid Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid; a dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland; musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E07 The Temp A temp worker hopes to turn her stint as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help; a wedding is interrupted; local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto; Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E08 Soft Opening Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the soft opening of their bed and breakfast; a magazine features a local furniture maker in their Man Issue; steampunks attend a convention; Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E09 Alexandra The City of Portland is overrun with art projects; Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate Alexandra; a movie theater sells artisanal concessions. Kath and Dave are concerned about the coyotes in their neighborhood.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E10 No-Fo-O-Fo-Bridge The Rats decide to move out of their newly-gentrified neighborhood; first-time parents read various child-rearing books; Gavin and his girlfriend go to the movies; Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E11 Blackout Electricity is shut off for the entire city as a result of unpaid bills at the Mayor's office; Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E01 Sharing Finances A young woman is haunted by very smart ghosts; Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another; Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes; Sandra finally finds a soul mate; Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E02 Ecoterrorists Ecoterrorists protest animal testing at a makeup company; Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out!; Toni and Candace have a car wash; Fred misses hip hop; Dave helps Kath get a good night's sleep.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.description: S04 E04 Pull-Out King A punk from the 1980s wakes up from a coma; an e-mail goes neglected; Nina has surprising news for Lance; Malcolm and Kris tailgate a "Prairie Home Companion" live show; Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

reelzchannel.us.description: Routine calls explode into wild pursuits, standoffs, and arrests across Oklahoma. From a retired deputy fighting a burglar to suspects fleeing, tossing evidence, and refusing commands, these clips show how fast control can vanish. (Reality, Law) - 2026-09-11

reelzchannel.us.title: On Patrol: Live Special - Fleeing Suspects Learn Tennessee Deputies Don't Back Down
reelzchannel.us.description: Knox County deputies find themselves in a slow-speed pursuit with a minivan on a highway. Deputies eventually get the driver to stop at an intersection and take her into custody. Then, deputies lose a fleeing suspect when the driver exits the interstate. Deputies search the area near trailer homes and find two suspects hiding out in separate spots. (Reality, Law) - 2026-09-11

reelzchannel.us.title: On Patrol: Live Special - 10 Heroic Moments of Cops Rescuing Strangers
reelzchannel.us.description: Officers race to a variety of emergencies, including water rescues, vehicle crashes, missing persons and other dangerous situations. (Reality, Law) - 2026-10-24

reelzchannel.us.title: On Patrol: Live Special - Chases, Crashes & Confrontations
reelzchannel.us.description: In Richland County, deputies force a man out of his apartment after he runs from a traffic stop. Next, Fullerton police and a SWAT team face off with a naked man who barricaded himself in his home and threatened his family with a knife. Also, Berkeley County deputies take on a suspect hiding in an apartment after fleeing a shooting scene. Lastly, Berkeley County deputies remove a man hiding in his home after fleeing on a motorcycle. (Reality, Law) - 2026-09-12

reelzchannel.us.title: On Patrol: Live Special - 10 Shocking Police Calls That Turn Into Absolute Mayhem
reelzchannel.us.description: From a porta-potty standoff to a stabbing with guns involved, drunk drivers hauling stolen booze, and a high-speed chase ending in a tense extraction. (Reality, Law) - 2026-09-04

retroplex.us.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
retroplex.us.description: After a successful baseball career in college and as a coach in the military, Jackie Robinson (playing himself) attracts the attention of Major League Baseball's Branch Rickey (Minor Watson). Rickey wants Robinson to play in the minor leagues, believing he can become the first player to break the color barrier and play in the majors. The only catch: He is forbidden from defending himself against racial bigotry. Supported by his wife (Ruby Dee), Robinson is steadfast in his determination to win.

retroplex.us.title: American Heart
retroplex.us.description: This unflinching drama tells the story of recently released ex-convict Jack Kelson (Jeff Bridges) as he struggles to begin a new life outside of prison and build a relationship with his estranged teenage son Nick (Edward Furlong). With the deck stacked against them, Jack falls back on old habits as they struggle amid the vagrants and criminals of an impoverished section of Seattle. Just when it appears that they might succeed, Jack's past comes back to haunt him.

retroplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
retroplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history.

rifftrax.us.description: What happens when a public television studio realizes that it has to spend $2,000 of government grant money before Wednesday in order to qualify for full funding for the next fiscal year? You get Your Chance to Live: Technological Failures!

rifftrax.us.title: Best of RiffTrax: Villains - Best of RiffTrax: Villains
rifftrax.us.description: For this Best of, we wanted to focus on some of the more overlooked villains in our catalogue. Though they may not be iconic, these nefarious scoundrels' deeds are no less evil, their laughter is no less insane, and their ponytails are no less greasy.

screenpix.us.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
screenpix.us.description: While preparations are underway for the marriage of Athenian duke Theseus (Derek Godfrey) and Amazon queen Hippolyta (Barbara Jefford), fairy king Oberon (Ian Richardson) and his tricky jester, Puck (Ian Holm), make mischief with the indiscriminate use of a powerful love potion. Lysander (David Warner) and Demetrius (Michael Jayston) both fall for Helena (Diana Rigg), raising the jealousy of Hermia (Helen Mirren), whose father is pressuring her to marry Demetrius despite Lysander's love for her.

screenpix.us.title: The Caretakers
screenpix.us.description: Dr. MacLeod, a psychiatrist, has developed a new type of therapy for severely disturbed individuals at a mental institution. However, head nurse Lucretia Terry resists these changes, feeling that the only effective ways of dealing with patients are force and punishment. Even though MacLeod is rebuffed by many of the hospital staff, his methods show promise on some patients, including the frenzied Lorna Melford.

screenpix.us.title: Legend of the Lost
screenpix.us.description: Brit Paul Bonnard (Rossano Brazzi) enlists gruff American Joe January (John Wayne) to help him find a hidden treasure that is worth a fortune. Before long, they are joined by prostitute Dita (Sophia Loren), who is moved by Bonnard's earnestness, and the three embark on a journey through the wild in hopes of finding an ancient lost city. They finally stumble upon the riches, but, after Bonnard feuds with Dita, he angrily takes the jewels and supplies, and leaves his partners to die in the desert.

screenpix.us.title: Billie

Nervously, he starts setting Billie up with dates, unaware that she has a crush on her classmate, Mike (Warren Berlinger). (movie) - 1965

screenpix.us.title: The First Time
screenpix.us.description: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them. (movie) - 1969

screenpix.us.title: Cul-de-Sac
screenpix.us.description: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues. (movie) - 1966

screenpix.us.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
screenpix.us.description: While preparations are underway for the marriage of Athenian duke Theseus (Derek Godfrey) and Amazon queen Hippolyta (Barbara Jefford), fairy king Oberon (Ian Richardson) and his tricky jester, Puck (Ian Holm), make mischief with the indiscriminate use of a powerful love potion. Lysander (David Warner) and Demetrius (Michael Jayston) both fall for Helena (Diana Rigg), raising the jealousy of Hermia (Helen Mirren), whose father is pressuring her to marry Demetrius despite Lysander's love for her. (movie) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Little Norse Prince Valiant
screenpixaction.us.description: A Norwegian prince fights evil with a rock man's sword of the sun.

screenpixaction.us.title: Jack the Giant Killer
screenpixaction.us.description: Desiring control of the kingdom, an evil wizard, Pendragon (Torin Thatcher), devises a cunning machination to usurp the throne. By abducting Princess Elaine (Judi Meredith) and forcing her to marry him, Pendragon will coerce the king (Dayton Lummis) into abdicating his power. When Pendragon sends a giant to kidnap Elaine, a simple farmer, Jack (Kerwin Mathews), witnesses the abduction, and bravely slays the beast. Undeterred, Pendragon has more power and creatures at his disposal.

screenpixaction.us.title: No Such Thing
screenpixaction.us.description: Disgusted with human evolution, a foul-mouthed monster kills anyone who crosses his path. When a news crew sent to investigate the monster disappears, a guileless young woman is dispatched to follow up on the story. She befriends the monster and becomes his only hope in ending his life of misery.

screenpixaction.us.title: Mystery of the 13th Guest
screenpixaction.us.description: A young woman opens her grandfather's will when she turns 21, and someone starts murdering the heirs.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Walking Target
screenpixaction.us.description: An ex-con finds unexpected romance with the widow of his former accomplice as he tries to collect his hidden loot.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Nun and the Sergeant
screenpixaction.us.description: A Marine (Robert Webber) leads misfits on a mission in Korea with a nun (Anna Sten) and Asian schoolgirls for company.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Young Racers
screenpixaction.us.description: Auto racing hotshot Joe Machin (William Campbell) lives in the fast lane, cultivating a reputation as a wild card and a womanizer. Machin's rowdy ways get him into trouble, however, when Stephen Children (Mark Damon), the rejected fiancé of one of the driver's many lovers, decides to get revenge. A former racer who is now a writer, Children joins Machin's pit crew in order to dig up the dirt on his romantic rival. However, there may be more to Machin than meets the eye.

screenpixaction.us.title: Warriors of Virtue
screenpixaction.us.description: Lame in one leg, Ryan Jeffers has few friends in his high school and spends most of his time with Chinese restaurant chef Ming, who gives him the Book of Tao. When he is goaded by the football team into a dangerous ceremony, Ryan falls into a whirlpool and emerges in the magical land of Tao. His leg fully healed, he is led to Master Chung, whose heroic warriors battle against greedy Lord Komodo. Ryan joins their fight.

screenpixaction.us.title: Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
screenpixaction.us.description: Round Table knight Gawain (Murray Head) beheads the Green Knight (Nigel Green), who expects a return stroke.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Boy and the Pirates
screenpixaction.us.description: On the beach near his home, Jimmy (Charles Herbert) finds a bottle that contains a genie named Abu (Joseph Turkel), who magically transports him to the ship of the pirate Blackbeard (Murvyn Vye). Abu explains that the bottle must be returned to its original location in three days, or Jimmy will take the genie's place. The pair spend a few eventful days with Blackbeard, evading capture, accompanied by a girl (Susan Gordon) they rescue, but Jimmy begins to wonder if he'll ever get back home.

screenpixaction.us.title: Code 46
screenpixaction.us.description: In a dystopian future, insurance fraud investigator William Geld (Tim Robbins) arrives in Shanghai to investigate a forgery ring for "papelles," futuristic passports that record people's identities and genetics. Geld falls for Maria Gonzalez (Samantha Morton), the woman in charge of the forgeries. After a passionate affair, Geld returns home, having named a coworker as the culprit. But when one of Gonzalez's customers is found dead, Geld is sent back to Shanghai to complete the investigation. (movie) - 2003

screenpixvoices.us.title: Love Chronicles
screenpixvoices.us.description: A disc jockey and a therapist help callers on a radio program sort through their relationship issues.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hurricane Streets
screenpixvoices.us.description: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Gabriela
screenpixvoices.us.description: A rich Turkish bar owner (Sônia Braga) falls in love with his beautiful Brazilian cook (Marcello Mastroianni).

screenpixvoices.us.title: Go Fish
screenpixvoices.us.description: After leaving behind her girlfriend to attend college in Chicago, young lesbian Max West (Guinevere Turner) is introduced to Ely (V.S. Brodie), a slightly older woman with quirky habits. While Max and Ely quickly develop an attraction to each other, a poorly timed phone call from Max's long-distance girlfriend, Kate, brings things to an abrupt halt. Meanwhile, Max's roommate, Kia (T. Wendy McMillan), helps her girlfriend, Evy (Migdalia Melendez), cope with some tough times at home.

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Perez Family
screenpixvoices.us.description: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Belle of the Yukon
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sam Whiskey
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Another Man, Another Chance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Jeanne (Geneviève Bujold), a young woman, falls for a photographer named Francis (Francis Huster), he convinces her to leave war-torn France and move to America with him. After they have set up a photography shop and have a baby, Francis dies. A few years later, Jeanne meets David (James Caan), a solitary man who cannot forget the murder of his wife. Jeanne and David start a relationship, but she worries that his dangerous search for his wife's killers threatens their love.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Comanche
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Promised Land
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A town full of former outlaws kidnaps Bat and expects him to work as their trusty banker.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Conspiracy
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat finds himself involved in the Lincoln assassination conspiracy 15 years after the crime.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Hostage
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Murderer Sam Edwards has been sentenced to hang, but his brother, John, kidnaps Harris and takes him hostage to save Sam from the gallows.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Governor
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister risks his life to rescue the governor, who has been kidnapped by a gang.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: War Paint
screenpixwesterns.us.description: With only nine days to deliver a peace treaty to the chief of a strong Native American tribe, Lt. Billings (Robert Stack) and his troopers are in a race against time to avoid all-out war. Since time is of the essence, Billings recruits the chief's son, Taslik (Keith Larsen), to guide the men to the village. However, Billings and his men are unaware that a group of renegades, wary of the suspicious U.S. treaty, seek to kill the messengers before they can complete their mission.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Wanda Nevada
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the American Southwest of the 1950s, middle-aged vagabond Beaudray Demerille (Peter Fonda) survives as a cardsharp who moves from town to town. But his latest victory brings him unwanted spoils in the form of Wanda Nevada (Brooke Shields), a fiery 13-year-old. At first Beaudray does everything he can to ditch Wanda -- until the girl chances upon a treasure map. But Wanda and Beaudray aren't the only ones after the loot, and they must contend with a ruthless pair of crooks.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Dog's Best Friend
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Black Pearls
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat agrees to pose as a prisoner to gain the confidence of a criminal who hid a string of black pearls he stole, but when the man's sister arrives his job gets harder. (Western) - 1959-07-01

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Kidnapping
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hope Jensen turns in a bag of stolen money that her husband had been forced to hide in their barn by Ben Jensen and his gang. (Western) - 1960-04-22

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Girl from Philadelphia
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Belle Reed's sister poses as her, with hopes of trapping her killer. (Western) - 1960-04-22

scrippsnews.us.description: Jefferson Graham shows off the most Instagram-worthy landmarks across the US through the lens of his smartphone.

scrippsnews.us.title: Photowalks On Scripps News - Christmas In Japan
scrippsnews.us.description: Jefferson Graham does Christmas in Japan as he leads Photowalks through glittering illumination displays, capturing festive street scenes, markets and temple lights.

scrippsnews.us.title: Photowalks On Scripps News - Atlanta
scrippsnews.us.description: Join Jefferson Graham of Photowalks to see the sights of Atlanta with Scripps News anchor Holly Firfer. Learn to take iconic pictures of the most walkable areas in the city.

scrippsnews.us.title: Photowalks On Scripps News - Indianapolis Family History
scrippsnews.us.description: Jefferson Graham takes Photowalks to his family's hometown of Indianapolis, Indiana to take photos of his grandparents' former home and see what other discoveries he can find in the public library records.

scrippsnews.us.title: Scripps Special: Years Million Stories ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
scrippsnews.us.description: Celebrating the impact and success of a powerful program, delivering the two millionth book to a child in our schools.

scrippsnews.us.title: Edge of Extinction: The Last Vaquita ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
scrippsnews.us.description: Exclusive access to the frontlines of a fight to save the world's most endangered marine mammal: the vaquita.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Shaquille O'Neal
scrippsnews.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Kristen Bell
scrippsnews.us.description: Actress Kristen Bell recounts how her nurturing nature and her good works, such as co-founding No Kid Hungry, was sparked when she was age 19 and helped deliver two babies during a missionary trip to a clinic in Brazil.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Samuel L. Jackson & LaTanya Richardson Jackson
scrippsnews.us.description: Actors/spouses Samuel and LaTanya Jackson have fought for civil rights around the globe, but their greatest satisfaction comes from handwritten thank you notes from children they have supplied with books.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - LeVar Burton
scrippsnews.us.description: Inspired by his mother to be "of service," LeVar Burton entered the seminary at 13 years old; after deciding the Church didn't have the answers to his life questions, he changed his focus to theater arts and became known for Roots and Star Trek.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - 2018 SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama
secnetwork.us.description: Jalen Hurts comes off the bench to pass for one touchdown and run for another in the fourth quarter, rallying No. 1 Alabama to a win over No. 4 Georgia for the SEC championship. From Dec. 1, 2018.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - 2020 SEC Championship: Florida vs. Alabama
College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 1 Bulldogs (12-0, 8-0) try to solve the No. 3 Crimson Tide (11-1, 7-1) in the SEC title game. Alabama has won six straight meetings since 2008, including the 2012 and 2018 SEC title tilts as well as the 2018 national championship game.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: LSU vs. Georgia
secnetwork.us.description: The Bulldogs face the Tigers in the 2022 SEC Championship Game from Atlanta. This is a rematch of the 2019 edition where Joe Burrow and LSU bested Georgia 37-10 en route to a national title. Georgia's last loss came in a 2021 match against Alabama. (sports) - 2022-12-03

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama
secnetwork.us.description: No. 1 Georgia plays No. 8 Alabama in the SEC Championship game. This marks the first meeting since the Bulldogs beat the Crimson Tide in the 2021 national championship game. The two schools have combined to win eight of the past nine SEC titles. (sports) - 2023-12-02

shadesofblack.us.description: When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
shadesofblack.us.description: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

shadesofblack.us.title: Chaos
shadesofblack.us.description: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Women of Brewster Place
shadesofblack.us.description: A multigenerational story of the lives of several black women who call an inner-city tenement home.

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
shadesofblack.us.description: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
shadesofblack.us.description: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

shoutmovies.us.title: Eraserhead

skyselect.uk.title: My Christmas Cowboy (2026)
skyselect.uk.description: Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, they reunite in a small Texas town to save an annual holiday event.

skyselect.uk.title: Arthur Christmas (2011)
skyselect.uk.description: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur (James McAvoy), Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

skyselect.uk.title: A Boy Called Christmas (2021)
skyselect.uk.description: An ordinary young boy called Nikolas sets out on an adventure into the snowy north in search of his father who is on a quest to discover the fabled village of the elves, Elfhelm. Taking with him a headstrong reindeer called Blitzen and a loyal pet mouse, Nikolas soon meets his destiny.

skyselect.uk.title: Jack Frost (1998)
skyselect.uk.description: A musician who neglects his family in pursuit of his career is tragically killed in a car accident, but is given a second chance to get back into his son's life when he is reincarnated as a snowman.

skyselect.uk.title: Nativity! (2009)
skyselect.uk.description: A primary school teacher, who was once a failed actor in a former career, is given the task of directing the school's Nativity play, which doesn't have a positive track record. Attitudes change however, when it transpires that a Hollywood producer is coming to film the play.

skyselect.uk.title: Nativity 2: Danger in the Manger! (2012)
skyselect.uk.description: A new teacher juggles his pregnant wife and a class of children on a road trip.

skyselect.uk.title: Nativity 3: Dude Where's My Donkey? (2014)
skyselect.uk.description: An Ofsted inspector arrives at St. Bernadette's and forgets who he is.

skyselect.uk.title: Elf (2003)
skyselect.uk.description: Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for. (Comedy / Fantasy / Children / Holiday) - 2003

skyselect.uk.title: The Grinch (2018)
skyselect.uk.description: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all. - 2018

skyselect.uk.title: Genie (2023)
skyselect.uk.description: With his life unraveling around him, Bernard dusts off a jewelry box and unintentionally releases genie Flora, who might just be able to help him. - 2023

skyselect.uk.title: Last Christmas (2019)
skyselect.uk.description: Nothing seems to go right for young Kate, a frustrated Londoner who works as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop. But things soon take a turn for the better when she develops a growing attraction to a charming suitor who seems too good to be true. (Romantic comedy / Holiday) - 2019

skyselect.uk.title: Tinsel Town (2025)
skyselect.uk.description: A washed-up Hollywood action hero takes a role in a small English village's quirky Christmas pantomime, where he finds unexpected inspiration through the show's straight-talking dance instructor. (Comedy / Holiday) - 2025

sonymoviechannel.us.description: A border-patrol agent (Jean-Claude Van Damme) must stop renegade Special Forces soldiers from smuggling heroin into the United States.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Gladiator
sonymoviechannel.us.description: After whipping a rival in a brawl, Chicago teen Tommy Riley (James Marshall) is asked to box in the illegal fights organized by Jimmy Horn (Brian Dennehy). Tommy has bigger aspirations, but when Jimmy agrees to cover the betting debts his father (John Heard) incurred, Tommy agrees. He soon befriends Abraham Lincoln Haines (Cuba Gooding Jr.), a black boxer helping to support his family. When Jimmy realizes that the friends are his two top draws, he matches them in a bout neither wants.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Mercenary
sonymoviechannel.us.description: An electronics mogul (John Ritter) coerces a former commander (Olivier Gruner) into helping him find the terrorist who killed his wife.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Planet Action
sonymoviechannel.us.description: A look at how celebrities are stepping up to make a difference in the world and hopefully inspiring others to do the same.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: The Deep
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Limbo
sonymoviechannel.us.description: After a traumatic accident years ago that left others dead, Joe Gastineau has lived a life full of guilt, leading a solitary existence as a fisherman in Alaska. After he meets lounge singer Donna, he starts to fall for her and open up. However, when Joe's half brother returns, asking for help, it sends Joe, Donna and her daughter, Noelle, on a boat ride that will change their lives.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Hudson Hawk
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Thief extraordinaire Hudson Hawk has just been released from prison and all he wants is a nice cappuccino. However, before he can savor his favorite beverage, the highly eccentric and wealthy Darwin Mayflower and his equally odd wife, Minerva, rope Hawk into an ambitious series of heists. Soon Hawk is stealing no less than major works by Leonardo da Vinci, priceless pieces that the Mayflowers plan to use in an exceedingly nefarious way.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Sunset
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Having retired from a life of gunfights and peacekeeping, the great Wyatt Earp (James Garner) has landed a job as adviser to a Western movie about himself. On the set of the silent picture, he gets to know Tom Mix (Bruce Willis), an actor who specializes in Westerns, who has been hired to portray Earp. Not long after making each other's acquaintance, they find out that Earp's ex-girlfriend's son is missing, and the man responsible may be studio chief Alfie Alperin (Malcolm McDowell).

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Bite the Bullet
sonymoviechannel.us.description: A disparate group of individuals enters a horse race through 700 miles of the Wild West to win a large cash prize. The contestants include two ex-Rough Riders (Gene Hackman, James Coburn), an aging cowboy who refuses to slow down (Ben Johnson), an inexperienced youth (Jan-Michael Vincent), a Mexican (Mario Arteaga), an Englishman (Ian Bannen) and a woman (Candice Bergen). Over the course of the trek, the riders begin to shed their biases toward gender, race and age, and appreciate one another. (movie) - 1975

sonymoviechannel.us.title: At Any Price
sonymoviechannel.us.description: An ambitious Iowa seed farmer (Dennis Quaid) tries to get his resentful son (Zac Efron) interested in the family business, but the young man would rather pursue a career in auto racing. (movie) - 2012

sonymoviechannel.us.title: The Lazarus Project
sonymoviechannel.us.description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital. (movie) - 2008

starz.us.title: Alarum
starz.us.description: Living off the grid while vacationing at a winter resort, married spies Joe and Lara come under fire from members of the old guard who suspect they've joined an elite team of rogue spies.

starz.us.title: Fifty Shades of Grey (Extended Version)
starz.us.description: When college senior Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan) for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure.

starz.us.title: Enough
starz.us.description: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman.

starz.us.title: Pain & Gain
starz.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.

starz.us.title: Jurassic World
starz.us.description: Located off the coast of Costa Rica, the Jurassic World luxury resort provides a habitat for an array of genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex. When the massive creature escapes, it sets off a chain reaction that causes the other dinos to run amok. Now, it's up to a former military man and animal expert to use his special skills to save two young brothers and the rest of the tourists from an all-out, prehistoric assault.

starz.us.title: Beast
starz.us.description: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built. (movie) - 2026

starz.us.title: The Preacher's Wife
starz.us.description: A cleric begins to doubt himself and is visited by an angel. The heavenly emissary is supposed to help the good reverend over his midlife crisis, but he is distracted by the cleric's lovely young wife. A remake with gospel music of the "The Bishop's Wife". (movie) - 1996

starz.us.description: A covert team of elite operatives live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival. (movie) - 2026

starzcinema.us.title: Fierce People
starzcinema.us.description: Finn (Anton Yelchin) is a teenager trying to escape his drug-addicted mother (Diane Lane) by going to study tribal people. His hopes are dashed when he gets caught scoring drugs for her, and she decides to start their lives over by moving them in with her massage client, billionaire Ogden (Donald Sutherland). At first, Finn indulges in the luxury around him and falls for Ogden's granddaughter (Kristen Stewart), but he soon finds that the rich can be more savage than any group in the wild.

starzcinema.us.title: Dìdi
starzcinema.us.description: In 2008, during the last month of summer before high school begins, an impressionable 13-year-old Taiwanese American boy learns what his family can't teach him: how to skate, how to flirt, and how to love his mom.

starzcinema.us.title: Lesbian Vampire Killers
starzcinema.us.description: Two best buddies (James Corden, Mathew Horne) encounter a nest of beautiful Sapphic bloodsuckers.

starzcinema.us.title: The Parts You Lose
starzcinema.us.description: A fugitive forms an unlikely bond with a deaf child when he takes refuge in an abandoned barn on the boy's family's farm.

starzcinema.us.title: It Only Takes a Night
starzcinema.us.description: After one of them experiences a brutal breakup, four friends go on a wild night out. Meant to be a distraction, the night turns into a life-altering series of events none of them will ever forget.

starzcinema.us.title: 2 Days in Paris
starzcinema.us.description: A European vacation was intended to repair the tattered relationship between American Jack (Adam Goldberg) and French native Marion (Julie Delpy). But, by the time they arrive in Paris to visit Marion's family, it is clear the trip is not going well. The city brings out aspects of Marion that only alienate neurotic Jack further, from her in-your-face politics to her former boyfriends, who surface in every café. Thus, the most romantic city in the world could mean the end of the couple's romance.

starzcinema.us.title: Whitney Houston in Focus
starzcinema.us.description: The untold story of photographer Bette Marshall and her one-time muse, an unknown eighteen-year-old singer the world would come to know as Whitney Houston.

starzcinema.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
starzcinema.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court.

starzcinema.us.title: Death Defying Acts
starzcinema.us.description: Upon arriving in Edinburgh, Scotland for a series of mind-boggling performances, master illusionist Harry Houdini (Guy Pearce) offers an impressive cash reward to any supposed psychic who can accurately tell him his late mother's exact last words. Gorgeous swindler Mary McGarvie (Catherine Zeta-Jones) rises to the challenge and engages Houdini in a dangerous flirtation that will blur the line between reality and paranoia -- and test the very limits of his skepticism.

starzcinema.us.title: The Girl in the Spider's Web
starzcinema.us.description: Fired from the National Security Agency, Frans Balder recruits hacker Lisbeth Salander to steal Firewall, a computer program that can access codes for nuclear weapons worldwide. The download soon draws attention from an NSA agent who traces the activity to Stockholm. Further problems arise when Russian thugs take Lisbeth's laptop and kidnap a math whiz who can make Firewall work. Now, Lisbeth and an unlikely ally must race against time to save the boy and recover the codes to avert disaster. (movie) - 2018

starzcomedy.us.title: Thoroughbreds
starzcomedy.us.description: Childhood friends Lily and Amanda reconnect in suburban Connecticut after years of growing apart. Lily has turned into a polished upper-class teenager who has a fancy boarding school on her transcript and a coveted internship on her resume. Amanda has developed a sharp wit and her own particular attitude but all in the process of becoming a social outcast. Though they initially seem completely at odds, the pair eventually bond and hatch a plan to solve both of their problems.

starzcomedy.us.title: Boy Eats Girl
starzcomedy.us.description: After declaring his love to his girlfriend, a teenager dies and comes back as a flesh-craving zombie.

starzcomedy.us.title: The Break-Up
starzcomedy.us.description: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

starzcomedy.us.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
starzcomedy.us.description: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

starzcomedy.us.title: Barefoot
starzcomedy.us.description: The black sheep of a wealthy family brings a naive, sheltered young woman (Evan Rachel Wood) home for his brother's wedding.

starzcomedy.us.title: Bandslam
starzcomedy.us.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

starzcomedy.us.title: No Strings Attached
starzcomedy.us.description: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

In keeping with the holiday spirit, the judge gives Davey one last chance at redemption, spend the holiday performing community service as the assistant referee for the youth basketball league or go to jail. Davey thinks he's gotten off easy until he meets Whitey Duvall, the eccentric, elf-like head referee. (movie) - 2002

starzencore.us.title: Michael
starzencore.us.description: The journey of pop star Michael Jackson, from his early days to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world. (movie) - 2026

starzencore.us.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
starzencore.us.description: After a gentle alien becomes stranded on Earth, the being is discovered and befriended by a young boy named Elliott. Bringing the extraterrestrial into his suburban California house, Elliott introduces E.T., as the alien is dubbed, to his brother and his little sister, Gertie, and the children decide to keep its existence a secret. Soon, however, E.T. falls ill, resulting in government intervention and a dire situation for both Elliott and the alien. (movie) - 1982

starzencoreaction.us.title: Cooties
starzencoreaction.us.description: Elementary-school teachers (Elijah Wood, Alison Pill, Rainn Wilson) come under attack from children who have been turned into vicious monsters by contaminated chicken nuggets.

starzencoreaction.us.title: Oblivion
starzencoreaction.us.description: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

starzencoreaction.us.title: John Henry
starzencoreaction.us.description: A quiet man with a violent past has his life changed when an immigrant girl who is on the run from gang violence in South Los Angeles stumbles into his life.

starzencoreaction.us.title: Pawn Shop Chronicles
starzencoreaction.us.description: An Elvis impersonator, meth-addicted white supremacists, and a man searching for his wife hunt for a missing wedding ring.

starzencoreaction.us.title: House of the Rising Sun
starzencoreaction.us.description: A former lawman (Dave Bautista) investigates a shooting death at a nightclub.

starzencoreaction.us.title: Salt
starzencoreaction.us.description: When Evelyn Salt (Angelina Jolie) became a CIA officer, she swore an oath to duty, honor and country. But, when a defector accuses her of being a Russian spy, Salt's oath is put to the test. Now a fugitive, Salt must use every skill gained from years of training and experience to evade capture, but the more she tries to prove her innocence, the more guilty she seems.

starzencoreaction.us.title: All Is Lost
starzencoreaction.us.description: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran mariner (Robert Redford) awakes to find his vessel taking on water after a collision with a stray shipping container. With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life. With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own mortality.

Rafe eventually determines that Caleb is in the thrall of Lilith (Angie Everhart), a powerful vampire who operates a seedy brothel. When Rafe and Katherine set out to rescue Caleb, they must contend with the lethal Lilith and her evil minions. (movie) - 1996

starzencoreaction.us.title: Shaun of the Dead
starzencoreaction.us.description: Shaun is a 30-something loser with a dull, easy existence. When he's not working at the electronics store, he lives with his slovenly best friend, Ed, in a small flat on the outskirts of London. The only unpredictable element in his life is his girlfriend, Liz, who wishes desperately for Shaun to grow up and be a man. When the town is inexplicably overrun with zombies, Shaun must rise to the occasion and protect both Liz and his mother. (movie) - 2004

starzencoreblack.us.title: The Knife
starzencoreblack.us.description: A family's life gets thrown into disarray when they find a mysterious woman in their new home. By the time the police arrive, the intruder is lying unconscious on the floor with a knife in her hand. Questioned by a detective, the couple and their two children try to safeguard one another's secrets. However, the choices they make soon lead to consequences even graver than they could have imagined.

starzencoreblack.us.title: What Men Want
starzencoreblack.us.description: Passed up for a well-deserved promotion, sports agent Ali Davis wonders what else she needs to do to succeed in a man's world. Hoping to find answers from a psychic, Ali drinks a weird concoction that suddenly allows her to hear what men are thinking. Using her newfound ability, Ali starts to turn the tables on her obnoxious male colleagues while racing to sign the next basketball superstar.

starzencoreblack.us.title: Marshall
starzencoreblack.us.description: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty.

starzencoreblack.us.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
starzencoreblack.us.description: After losing his mother to murder as a boy, Marcus (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) has little support in his life. He starts working for drug dealer Levar (Bill Duke) and his assistant (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje). Although Marcus makes good money selling, his dream is to become a rapper. When he reunites with an old love (Joy Bryant) and is later shot numerous times during a robbery, Marcus decides it's time to change his life. However, his old associates won't let him go so easily.

starzencoreblack.us.title: First Sunday
starzencoreblack.us.description: Petty thieves Durell and LeeJohn face a big problem: The two must come up with $17,000 in one week, or Durell will no longer be able to see his son. The goofy scoundrels embark on a haphazard plan to rob the neighborhood church, but they find the mission trickier than expected. When they arrive, they discover that somebody equally disreputable has already had his hand in the coffers. Now, they must trace the money to a group of parishioners.

starzencoreclassic.us.description: FBI agent Jake Harris (Val Kilmer) escorts a group of cadets to a remote island for simulation training. The cadets, under the leadership of J.D. (Christian Slater), will try to catch an imaginary serial killer within the island's elaborate facility. The FBI, however, is suspicious of Harris' methods and dispatch Gabe Jensen (LL Cool J) to act as an outside observer. What he finds is a simulation exercise that becomes dangerously real and training that becomes a fight for survival.

starzencoreclassic.us.description: As a zombie plague spreads across India, an American turbine engineer (Joseph Millson) battles his way back to Mumbai to rescue his pregnant lover (Meenu Mishra).

But when Danny turns one of Rick's songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves, even if it means risking everything he cares about.

starzencorewest.us.title: Pixels
starzencorewest.us.description: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

starzencorewest.us.title: The Longest Yard
starzencorewest.us.description: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

starzencorewest.us.title: A Bad Moms Christmas

When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

When the massive creature escapes, it sets off a chain reaction that causes the other dinos to run amok. Now, it's up to a former military man and animal expert to use his special skills to save two young brothers and the rest of the tourists from an all-out, prehistoric assault.

starzwest.us.description: When college senior Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan) for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure.

She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman.

starzwest.us.title: Pain & Gain
starzwest.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.

syfy.us.description: Sarah (Elizabeth Olsen) is working with her father (Adam Trese) and uncle (Eric Sheffer Stevens) to renovate an old family home to prepare it for sale. Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.
