syfywest.us.title: Die Hard With a Vengeance
syfywest.us.description: Detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is now divorced, alcoholic and jobless after getting fired for his reckless behavior and bad attitude. He is called back into action, however, when a cryptic terrorist (Jeremy Irons) takes New York City hostage in a lethal game of "Simon Says" and refuses to speak with anyone but McClane. Teaming up with a street-savvy electrician named Zeus Carver (Samuel L. Jackson), McClane dashes through the city, trying to stay one step ahead of a murderous plot.

syfywest.us.title: Live Free or Die Hard
syfywest.us.description: As the nation prepares to celebrate Independence Day, veteran cop John McClane carries out another routine assignment: bringing in a computer hacker for questioning. Meanwhile, a tech-savvy villain named Thomas Gabriel launches an attack on America's computer infrastructure. As chaos descends around him, McClane must use old-fashioned methods to fight the high-tech threat.

syfywest.us.title: Safety Not Guaranteed
syfywest.us.description: A disaffected magazine intern (Aubrey Plaza) befriends an unusual guy (Mark Duplass), who is looking for a partner to accompany him on a trip back through time.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Shadow Play
syfywest.us.description: A condemned man tries to convince the people around him that everything and everyone is merely part of a recurring nightmare that always ends in his execution.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The Incredible World of Horace Ford
syfywest.us.description: A toy designer (Pat Hingle) visits his old neighborhood and finds it exactly as it was in his childhood.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The Prime Mover
syfywest.us.description: Two men try to make their fortune at Las Vegas from the power one of them has to move inanimate objects.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Perchance to Dream
syfywest.us.description: A terrified man stumbles into a psychiatrist's office, afraid that if he falls asleep a woman in his dream will murder him.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - In His Image
syfywest.us.description: A scientist (George Grizzard) creates a near-perfect mechanical man endowed with all the qualities he feels he is lacking.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - People Are Alike All Over
syfywest.us.description: An astronaut (Roddy McDowall) experiences Martian hospitality.

syfywest.us.title: Safety Not Guaranteed
syfywest.us.description: A disaffected magazine intern (Aubrey Plaza) befriends an unusual guy (Mark Duplass), who is looking for a partner to accompany him on a trip back through time. (movie) - 2012

syfywest.us.title: Silent House
syfywest.us.description: Sarah (Elizabeth Olsen) is working with her father (Adam Trese) and uncle (Eric Sheffer Stevens) to renovate an old family home to prepare it for sale. Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous. (movie) - 2011

syfywest.us.title: Halloween II
syfywest.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion. (movie) - 2009

syfywest.us.title: American Sniper
syfywest.us.description: U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle (Bradley Cooper) takes his sole mission -- protect his comrades -- to heart and becomes one of the most lethal snipers in American history. His pinpoint accuracy not only saves countless lives but also makes him a prime target of insurgents. Despite grave danger and his struggle to be a good husband and father to his family back in the States, Kyle serves four tours of duty in Iraq. However, when he finally returns home, he finds that he cannot leave the war behind. (movie) - 2014

talkingpictures.uk.title: Stagecoach West - The Marker
talkingpictures.uk.description: A jealous man pursues Luke and a woman to avenge his vanity.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Penguin's Nest
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Penguin opens an exclusive restaurant, The Penguin's Nest, which caters to Gotham's richest citizens. By a clever ruse he and his henchmen collect handwriting samples from his very exclusive guests.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Bird's Last Jest
talkingpictures.uk.description: Alfred is sent to The Penguin's Nest restaurant and ends up in a pie.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Directors - Sam Peckinpah
talkingpictures.uk.description: A portrait of Sam Peckinpah, the controversial, Academy Award-nominated screenwriter and director known for films like `The Wild Bunch', `Straw Dogs' and `The Getaway'.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Demobbed (1944)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Demobbed from the army, four troublesome soldiers are reunited with their old Sergeant.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Widow From Chicago (1930)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A New York policeman's sister avenges his slaying by tricking the gangster to blame.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Breaking Point (1961)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A young English businessman is a pawn in a plot to steal a shipment of cash from a Middle Eastern government.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Crown Court - Public Lives - Part 1
talkingpictures.uk.description: A theatre production company is charged with breaching obscenity laws following the performance of a play called 'Public Lives' at the Fulchester Palace Theatre. The performance, which included nudity and sex acts, led to dozens of complaints.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Crown Court - Public Lives - Part 2
talkingpictures.uk.description: Actress Mandy Jenkins tells how she was sacked from 'Public Lives' when she claimed the play became obscene. Author EW Appleby states he had his name removed from the credits, after the dress rehearsal, when the actors performed nude.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Crown Court - Public Lives - Part 3
talkingpictures.uk.description: Jeremy Williams continues giving evidence, in his defence, and denies making an indecent or obscene production. Michael Standing MP gives his views on censorship and compares the differences between theatre and television.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Pete Murray Takes You To Hastings
talkingpictures.uk.description: Pete Murray takes you along his travels through the picturesque and historical coastal town of Hastings.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Duchess of Duke Street - Plain Sailing
talkingpictures.uk.description: The vintage period drama from the creators of 'Upstairs, Downstairs', following life at a London hotel in the 1900s. Louisa's new neighbours are troublesome.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Profile (1954)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A magazine editor has an affair with the wife of a recently deceased publisher and winds up a prime murder suspect.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Call Northside 777 (1948)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Tense documentary-style thriller based on a true-life case, about a Chicago newspaper reporter who doggedly sets out to prove jailed Richard Conte is innocent of murder.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look at Life - Birdmen
talkingpictures.uk.description: A look at the origins of man-powered flight, focusing on John Wimpenny, the first man to pedal himself through the air for more than half a mile. Also featuring a look at today's attempts.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Weir's Way - Fast Castle to St Abb's Head
talkingpictures.uk.description: In this episode, Tom takes the 5-mile trek from the remarkable Fast Castle, built on crags and reckoned to have been built for shipwrecking to the popular summer destination of St Abbs.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers - A Bad Mistake
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1974. Stars Hilary Tindall, Gabrielle Drake & Colin Baker. Ann fears losing everything. Meanwhile, Edward meets prospective shareholders, but his honesty causes a setback. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1972

talkingpictures.uk.title: Mark Saber - Saber at Sea
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1958. Stars Donald Gray, Ann Stephens & Robert Arden. Saber helps a woman who has turned amateur detective upon finding a dead body aboard a cruise ship. (Crime, Drama, Entertainment) - 1954

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1975. Ronnie Hilton sings a number of hits, New World perform 'Kara, Kara' and 'Sister Jane'. David Copperfield, Valentino and Jimmy Marshall also star. (Comedy, Reality, Entertainment) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Unfaithfully Yours
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1984. Comedy. Directed by Howard Zieff. Stars Dudley Moore, Nastassja Kinski & Armand Assante. An orchestra conductor believes that his wife is cheating on him and concocts a plan to murder her. (Comedy, Romance, Movie) - 1948

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Reckless Moment - 1949. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Max Ophuls. Stars James Mason, Joan Bennett & Geraldine Brooks. Finding her daughter's lover dead, a housewife takes desperate measures to protect her family from scandal. (Crime, Drama, Thriller, Movie) - 1949

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Grubby Good Food
tastemade.us.description: Send your taste buds on a first class food tour without even leaving the Struggle kitchen! Frankie whips up his favorite regional specialties from five destinations, making them as authentic as possible while sticking to his budget.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Spice Spice Baby
tastemade.us.description: Frankie kicks it up a notch in the Struggle Kitchen with flavor-packed, spicy recipes, and some hot tips for adding layers of flavor. But don't sweat it, these warming dishes won't burn your cash or your taste buds.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - But First, Brunch
tastemade.us.description: Bring your loved ones together over a delicious brunch spread made with love. Whether you're celebrating a major milestone or simply toasting to the weekend, Frankie's money-saving menu will have guests buzzing for more.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - French Bistro
tastemade.us.description: Bonsoir, indeed! Join Frankie as he cooks up elegant but achievable French classics that will transport you to an evening on the Seine, complete with some savvy wine tips without the hefty cost of a plane ticket.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Struggle Splurge
tastemade.us.description: The key to treating yourself on a budget is to keep it simple: these elegant dinners taste like restaurant specials, but they can be prepared in under one hour - perfect for easy weeknight meals for a family of any size on a busy schedule.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Eat Your Greens
tastemade.us.description: Going green isn't just a trend; it's a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie's colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - We Knead Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Cancel the pizza delivery, it's time to save money and build your pies from scratch. With three different pizza styles, you're bound to find one that satisfies your craving without digging into your wallet.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Homemade-ish
tastemade.us.description: Last minute company leaving you in a pinch? Frankie has you covered with these easy recipes featuring store bought staples. With a few Struggle tips, these basic ingredients can be transformed into dishes that will impress your guests.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Pizza My Heart
tastemade.us.description: On this special delivery episode of Struggle Meals, Frankie explores three ways to make delicious pizzas, and shares clever tips to make an A+ pie without dropping your dough on expensive ingredients.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Whole Chicken 101
tastemade.us.description: Join Frankie to learn the ins and outs of using every part of a chicken, as he demonstrates how to maximize the value and minimize waste. By cooking smarter, you'll have three delectable recipes to last you the whole week.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Picnic Lunches
tastemade.us.description: It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Saved By The Bowl
tastemade.us.description: When you're craving a quick nutritious meal, say no more to throwing cash down the gutter for overpriced takeout bowls! Frankie recreates three restaurant favorites for a fraction of the cost, sparing your bank account without sacrificing flavor.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Meatless Mains
tastemade.us.description: Start a new tradition at the dinner table this year with a meat free spin on your favorite main courses. Learn new tips and tricks to make your veggie forward dinner so delightful that even the biggest meat eaters will be back for seconds.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - The Wonderful World of Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Lunch That Goes the Distance
tastemade.us.description: Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Pasta From Scratch
tastemade.us.description: Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce-from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Italian Smokehouse
tastemade.us.description: Frankie fires up a steakhouse-style spread with Italian flair from golden beets and buttery mushrooms to a sizzling Bistecca alla Fiorentina steak with salmoriglio sauce, and a smooth cold brew affogato granita.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Frankie's Feast of the Seven Fishes
tastemade.us.description: Frankie reimagines the Feast of the Seven Fishes with a shellfish-free spread making Smoked Whitefish Salad, Anchovy Butter Toast, Salt-baked Red Snapper, Trout Scapece, and Pasta con le Sarde, with a helping hand from his mom.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Thanksgiving Spatchcock & Sides
tastemade.us.description: Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Crispy Pork Noodles and Cheesy Chard Cannelloni
tastemade.us.description: Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E01 Comfy Campground Medical doctors and busy parents, Cynthia and Boon miss their camping adventures. Brian and Sarah perform some backyard surgery, and build them a cozy campground retreat so they can go straight from the ER to getting some R&R right in their own yard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 An Elevated Lower Level Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 New Generation Style Ashley and Colin can't wait to see how Nicole and Caffrey transform Ashley's grandmother's dated bungalow into their new, modern, family home; and Caffrey gets Nicole on board with giving his good friend Marlene a much-needed refresh of her home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Two Sisters, One Home Sisters Leandra and Alayna recently inherited their childhood home. So they've asked Nicole and Caffrey to transform it into a fresh, contemporary space while still honoring the past.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 100 Years Newer After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 A Dream Childhood Home Lauren's childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys, while real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Invest In Your Kitchen Diane and Bernard are downsizing. They're counting on Nicole and Caffrey to get them top dollar! And back in the city, Whitney is struggling to make her townhouse function properly. Nicole and Caffrey bring their magic to transform this townhouse!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Paid Off, Styled Up Finally mortgage-free, Denise is now ready for her main floor to go from bleak to chic. Nicole and Caffery will create a maximalist, welcoming space that reflects her larger than life personality!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 A Modern Home and Rental Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Suite Retreat Nicole and Caffrey design an executive rental suite to help supplement Vashti's path to retirement, while real estate agent Kelsey pursues Nicole and Caffrey's much-needed staging expertise to help sell her clients' colorful and chaotic townhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Old Plan to Open Floor Plan Sarah and Mark's house needs to be brought into the 21st century so Nicole and Caffery will create a new, timeless and functional design for their family; real estate pro Karina needs help morphing a virtually staged listing into a real showstopper.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Builder Basic to Modern Mohit and Kiru need Nicole and Caffrey to bring a 'styled' look to their very empty new home, and Andrea's trusting her first listing to these staging masters.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Fast Paced Roman Recipes
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Italian Alps Comfort Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Best of Salina's Land and Sea
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Making Pizza in Naples
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

tbn.us.title: Gaithers: In Everything Give Thanks
tbn.us.description: Celebrating Thanksgiving with the Gaither Vocal Band, Jeff & Sheri Easter, The Martins, Josh Turner and Mike Rogers in an evening of uplifting music and praise!

tbn.us.title: Joseph Prince
tbn.us.description: Stop Letting the World Feed Your Fear A thankful heart draws heaven's grace into your everyday life.

tbn.us.title: Charlie Kirk Today
tbn.us.description: Join Charlie Kirk as he breaks down the news, challenges the mainstream narrative and delivers commentary on faith, culture and politics; no spin, no censorship, just the truth.

tbn.us.title: The Story Behind the Story With Mike Rowe
tbn.us.description: S04 E18 A Nice Girl From Wisconsin Mike Rowe and Matt talk about a Syrian immigrant who unknowingly blew up the world with his creation.

tbn.us.title: Michael A. Youssef
tbn.us.description: Pastor Michael Youssef proclaims God's word to all the people around the world through the ministries of Leading The Way.

tbn.us.title: Healthy Aging With Mushrooms With Jordan Rubin
tbn.us.description: Discussing the benefits of Jordan Rubin and Josh Axe's product Lion's Mane supplements.

tbn.us.title: Vision Bible: The Making of Vision Bible
tbn.us.description: Learn how human creativity and AI tools work together to bring Scripture to life; follow real performances into finished biblical scenes and answer common AI concerns through the process itself.

tbn.us.title: Life Today ᴺᵉʷ
tbn.us.description: Anne Graham-Lotz: Hope for the Future The author of "The Vision of His Glory" shares the hope she found in John's revelation of Jesus.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Kick the Bucket List; Party Down
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde's spring break plans are put in jeopardy when they only have one day to complete their list; Lori throws a sophisticated party, but it backfires when her guests do not like what she has planned.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - White Hare; Insta-gran
teennick.us.description: Lincoln has a plan for introducing himself to a new girl; Pop Pop introduces his new girlfriend to the family; she seems great until she starts showing up unannounced.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Lori Days; In the Mick of Time
teennick.us.description: Lori makes a surprise visit to the house when she feels like she's missing out on the family's inside jokes; after embellishing her friendship with Mick Swagger, Luna has to convince the star to play her high school dance.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Sitting Bull; The Spies Who Loved Me
teennick.us.description: The older sisters reluctantly let Lynn into their baby-sitting club, but she quickly proves to be too aggressive; Ronnie Anne's grandparents decide to spy on her when she wants to go downtown.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Tripped!
teennick.us.description: During a road trip to their vacation destination, everything that can go wrong for the family does.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Yes Man; Friend or Faux
teennick.us.description: The sisters enlist Lincoln, the "Master of Convincing," to teach them how to ask their parents for money; when Lisa's report card reveals that she has failed social skills, she must make a friend in order to bring up her grade.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Study Muffin; Homespun
teennick.us.description: All of Lincoln's sisters develop a crush on his new tutor, making it impossible for Lincoln to study; the children complain about their house, but they start to feel differently after a tornado threatens to destroy it.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Patching Things Up; Cheater by the Dozen
teennick.us.description: Lola and Lana try out for Bluebell Scouts, but discover one of them might be more suited for it; when Lincoln and Clyde think Bobby is cheating on Lori, they follow him around town gathering evidence.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Roll Model With the Casagrandes; No Show With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: When Carl witnesses Ronnie Anne save a dog, he becomes obsessed with being just like his newfound hero; Ronnie Anne secretly starts watching her family's favorite telenovela after refusing to watch it with them.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Attention Deficit; Out on a Limo
teennick.us.description: Lincoln begins spending time at Clyde's house when Clyde's fathers give him more attention than he gets at home; when Lincoln wins a ride in a limo, he begins to change after getting a taste of the good life.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - How Double Dare You!; Snoop's On
teennick.us.description: The siblings turn to Lisa's intelligence to help them land a spot on "Double Dare"; after secretly reading Luna's diary, Leni and Lincoln become worried about the exploits their sister writes about.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Road Trip: Bizarritorium
teennick.us.description: Mom is assigned a travel article at work, and she takes the entire family on a cross-country road trip; the trip gets off to a bumpy start when Lincoln tries to change Mom's itinerary to go to Dr. Weirdly's Bizarritorium.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Crying Dame; Anti Social
teennick.us.description: The children give Lily an old singing toy from the attic to help her stop crying, but it quickly drives them crazy; the kids try to convince Dad of the wonders of modern technology after he declares war on their electronic devices.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Stage Plight; Antiqued Off
teennick.us.description: Luan tries out for the school play to get closer to her crush, Benny; when Clyde and schoolmate Zach begin bonding over a mutual interest in antiques, Lincoln quickly finds himself feeling like a third wheel.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Baby Steps; Brawl in the Family
teennick.us.description: When Clyde thinks that his parents are having another baby, he seeks Lincoln's advice on how to be a big brother; a fight breaks out in the Loud house when Lori and Leni buy identical dresses.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Really Loud Music
teennick.us.description: Hoping to win a songwriting contest, Luna contemplates whether she should go with a song that's true to her sound or try to make something that the whole world will love.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Appetite for Destruction; Frame on You
teennick.us.description: When Lily starts misbehaving at home, Mom and Dad think her new preschool friends might be the cause; when Rusty is wrongfully suspended, the Action News Team leaps into action to clear his name.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Sound of Silence; Space Invader
teennick.us.description: Lincoln uses sound-canceling ear buds to try and drown out his sisters; after Lynn and Lucy get in a fight, Lincoln agrees to let Lynn bunk in his room for one night.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Summer Camp: The Grate Outdoors; Summer Camp: Don't Lose Your Cool
teennick.us.description: At Camp Mastodon, Lynn pushes an overly-cautious Lisa to become more adventurous; when Lori learns her Camp Mastodon campers think she's uncool, she tries to impress them by breaking the rules.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loudest Thanksgiving
teennick.us.description: Faced with spending Thanksgiving apart, Lori and Bobby try to bring their crazy families together for the first time.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Lock 'N Loud; The Whole Picture
teennick.us.description: When Dad gets upset with the children for never locking the front door, they decide to take home security to the next level; when Lincoln accidentally erases his childhood photos, he and Clyde attempt to recreate them before his memory fades.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Stall Monitor; A Pimple Plan
teennick.us.description: Worried that his teacher has bad things to say about him, Lincoln tries to delay his parent-teacher conference; Luan wakes up with a pimple on the day of her first date with Benny, so she turns to the siblings for help.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Diss the Cook; For Sale by Loner
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is convinced the middle school lunch lady is holding a grudge against him and his older sisters; Mr. Grouse attempts to find some peace and quiet after moving away from the Louds.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Camped!
teennick.us.description: When Dad discovers that his childhood camp is closing, he decides to take the family for one final visit; they soon uncover a map that could lead to a treasure big enough to save the camp and prove the existence of an old camp legend.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Snow Escape; Snow News Day

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Love Birds; Rocket Men

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Gags to Riches; Sole Searching

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - How Double Dare You!; Snoop's On

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Crying Dame; Anti Social

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loudest Thanksgiving

that70sshow.us.description: Red is forced to fire an old friend; Kelso decides to give his relationship with Laurie another chance.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Cat Fight Club
that70sshow.us.description: Jackie and Red seethe when Laurie and Kelso begin dating again, and Jackie can't resist hauling off and hitting Laurie.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Moon Over Point Place
that70sshow.us.description: Eric (Topher Grace) is dismayed by a candid yearbook photo of Donna (Laura Prepon), while Hyde (Danny Masterson) has a run-in with the law.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Reefer Madness
that70sshow.us.description: Eric (Topher Grace) makes a mind-blowing confession to his father (Kurtwood Smith) after Red kicks Hyde (Danny Masterson) out of the house. With Mila Kunis.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Red Sees Red
that70sshow.us.description: Red (Kurtwood Smith) becomes a strict disciplinarian in the wake of Eric's (Topher Grace) confession. Shirley Jones, Charo and Spiro Papadatos guest star.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Hyde's Father
that70sshow.us.description: When Hyde (Danny Masterson) sneaks into a bar with the guys, he recognizes the bartender as his long-lost father, Bud (guest star Robert Hays).

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Too Old to Trick or Treat, Too Young to Die
that70sshow.us.description: The gang finds itself caught up in strange situations as Halloween festivities turn scary. With Topher Grace, Mila Kunis, Ashton Kutcher, Danny Masterson, Laura Prepon and Wilmer Valderrama.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Roller Disco
that70sshow.us.description: Sparks fly when Jackie and Fez (Mila Kunis, Wilmer Valderrama) team up for a roller disco contest; Red (Kurtwood Smith) is sued by a former employee.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Eric's Panties
that70sshow.us.description: Eric's cute new lab partner has the hots for him, and Donna finds a strange pair of panties in his car.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Baby Fever
that70sshow.us.description: While watching a friend's baby, Kitty decides that she wants another child; Donna and Eric talk about having children someday.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Jackie Bags Hyde
that70sshow.us.description: Jackie tries to make Hyde jealous by bringing a date to Red's annual barbecue; Bob hosts his own competing barbecue.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Hyde's Christmas Rager
that70sshow.us.description: Eric (Topher Grace) stumbles home from Hyde and Bud's (Danny Masterson, guest star Robert Hays) holiday bash and pukes in Red's (Kurtwood Smith) shoes.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Ice Shack
that70sshow.us.description: Everyone gets into hot water while playing a version of "The Newlywed Game" at the ice shack.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Who Wants It More?
that70sshow.us.description: Donna and Eric freeze each other out after getting into a fight about a school project on the Cold War.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Fez Gets the Girl
that70sshow.us.description: A new girl (guest star Allison Munn) dazzles Fez (Wilmer Valderrama); Hyde, Kelso and Jackie (Danny Masterson, Ashton Kutcher, Mila Kunis) compete for Donna's (Laura Prepon) extra Led Zeppelin ticket.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Dine and Dash
that70sshow.us.description: Kelso (Ashton Kutcher) invites the gang out to dinner and then abandons them before the bill comes. With Topher Grace and Laura Prepon.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Radio Daze
that70sshow.us.description: Eric turns green with envy when Donna interns at a radio station; Kelso becomes Jackie's slave for a week.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Donna's Panties
that70sshow.us.description: Eric (Topher Grace) pulls down Donna's (Laura Prepon) pants during a basketball game with the guys, revealing her granny panties.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Romantic Weekend
that70sshow.us.description: Red and Kitty's romantic weekend is ruined by the noisy guests in the room next door -- Eric and Donna.

that70sshow.us.description: Red and Eric (Kurtwood Smith, Topher Grace) are shamed into taking Kitty (Debra Jo Rupp) square dancing after forgetting her birthday.

that70sshow.us.description: Jackie (Mila Kunis) tests Kelso (Ashton Kutcher) on his feelings about maturity, fidelity and parenting before taking him back.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Eric's Naughty No-No
that70sshow.us.description: Eric has an eye-opening experience while watching an X-rated movie; Kitty's sophisticated sister pays a visit.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Holy Craps!
that70sshow.us.description: Kitty (Debra Jo Rupp) recruits Red (Kurtwood Smith) and the guys to help out at a church fund-raiser; Fez (Wilmer Valderrama) breaks up with Caroline (guest star Allison Munn). John Ratzenberger and Kevin McDonald guest star.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Fez Dates Donna
that70sshow.us.description: Fez (Wilmer Valderrama) pretends to date Donna (Laura Prepon) in order to get his psycho ex-girlfriend, Caroline (guest star Allison Munn), off his back.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Eric's Drunken Tattoo
that70sshow.us.description: Eric decides to get a tattoo after he reads an entry in Donna's journal revealing her wish for him to have a more dangerous side.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Canadian Road Trip
that70sshow.us.description: Fez loses his green card when the guys make a beer run to Canada; Kelso sings the Canadian National Anthem and saves the day.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Backstage Pass
that70sshow.us.description: Donna parties with band members following a concert and forgets that she left Eric outside waiting for her.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - The Promise Ring
that70sshow.us.description: When Eric presents Donna with a promise ring representing their future together, her response is not what he expects.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - It's a Wonderful Life
that70sshow.us.description: After his breakup with Donna, Eric receives a visit from a guardian angel (Wayne Knight), who shows him the value of love.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Eric's Depression
that70sshow.us.description: Eric locks himself in his bedroom for days after his breakup with Donna, ignoring the pleas of his parents.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Pinciotti vs. Forman
that70sshow.us.description: Eric and Donna squabble over their friends following their breakup; Red and Pastor Dave become buddies.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Hyde Gets the Girl
that70sshow.us.description: Eric tries to make Donna jealous by flirting with some girls at a party, while Hyde hooks up with an older woman.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Bye-Bye Basement
that70sshow.us.description: Kitty redecorates the basement after Hyde moves back in with the Formans; Fez takes up ballet to meet girls.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - The Relapse
that70sshow.us.description: Donna finds comfort in Eric's arms after her mother leaves, and Eric's convinced they're back together.

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Uncomfortable Ball Stuff
that70sshow.us.description: Donna agrees to go to a ball with Eric but insists they're not on a date; Bob meets an outspoken woman at the store.

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

themoviechannel.us.title: Fatal Attraction
themoviechannel.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

themoviechannel.us.title: Smoke Signals
themoviechannel.us.description: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes.

themoviechannel.us.title: The Experts

themoviechannel.us.title: An Unfinished Life
themoviechannel.us.description: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds.

themoviechannel.us.title: Godzilla
themoviechannel.us.description: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

themoviechannel.us.title: Paycheck
themoviechannel.us.description: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

tnt.us.title: Fred Claus
tnt.us.description: Of the two Claus brothers, Fred is the troublemaker and polar opposite of his saintly sibling, Nicholas. When Fred's criminal ways finally land him in trouble, Nicholas bails him out and brings him to the North Pole to work off the debt by making toys. The headaches mount for St. Nick, who must not only deal with his troublemaking brother, but also an efficiency expert, who has come to evaluate Santa's operation.

tnt.us.title: FBI - Compromised
tnt.us.description: After a key witness and a U.S. marshal are ambushed and killed, Maggie and OA must find the man who leaked the information that led to their murders.

tnt.us.title: FBI - The Armorer's Faith
tnt.us.description: When an illegal arms broker-turned-informant is assassinated, OA assumes his identity and goes undercover to stop the sale of dangerous weapons, with help from Maggie and their former FBI instructor.

tnt.us.title: FBI - Identity Crisis
tnt.us.description: When a judge and her daughter are murdered after she sentences a man to life in prison, Maggie and OA search for the killer; Dana has a history with the victim and a vested interest in the case.

tnt.us.title: FBI - A New Dawn
tnt.us.description: When an alt-right provocateur is murdered after giving a speech at a university in New York City, Maggie and OA investigate the school's more extreme political groups and rely on OA's sister, a student, for help.

tnt.us.title: FBI - Partners in Crime
tnt.us.description: Maggie and OA must find a couple that is responsible for a spree of violent armed robberies that led to the death of an off-duty police officer.

tnt.us.title: FBI - Double Bind
tnt.us.description: As the team works to rescue a 5-year-old kidnapping victim, Scola suspects the boy's mother isn't being forthcoming about why her son was targeted; Nina struggles to open up to Scola about matters in their relationship.

tnt.us.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
tnt.us.description: The last of five coveted "golden tickets" falls into the hands of a sweet but very poor boy. He and his grandpa then get a tour of the strangest chocolate factory in the world. The owner leads five young winners on a thrilling and often dangerous tour of his factory.

tnt.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tnt.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown.

tnt.us.title: The Polar Express
tnt.us.description: When a doubting young boy takes a train ride to the North Pole, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.

tnt.us.title: Four Christmases
tnt.us.description: When their plans for an exotic vacation fall apart, unmarried couple Brad (Vince Vaughn) and Kate (Reese Witherspoon) must spend Christmas Day trudging around to a quartet of family get-togethers. While Brad counts the hours till he can escape the onslaught of crazy relatives, Kate begins to wonder about her own choices and ponders whether her family members are so crazy after all.

tntwest.us.title: Fred Claus
tntwest.us.description: Of the two Claus brothers, Fred is the troublemaker and polar opposite of his saintly sibling, Nicholas. When Fred's criminal ways finally land him in trouble, Nicholas bails him out and brings him to the North Pole to work off the debt by making toys. The headaches mount for St. Nick, who must not only deal with his troublemaking brother, but also an efficiency expert, who has come to evaluate Santa's operation.

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Stalker
tntwest.us.description: While investigating the 2006 murder-suicide of a family, the team must contend with an obsessed, suicidal killer in a hostage situation.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - The Armorer's Faith
tntwest.us.description: When an illegal arms broker-turned-informant is assassinated, OA assumes his identity and goes undercover to stop the sale of dangerous weapons, with help from Maggie and their former FBI instructor.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Identity Crisis
tntwest.us.description: When a judge and her daughter are murdered after she sentences a man to life in prison, Maggie and OA search for the killer; Dana has a history with the victim and a vested interest in the case.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - A New Dawn
tntwest.us.description: When an alt-right provocateur is murdered after giving a speech at a university in New York City, Maggie and OA investigate the school's more extreme political groups and rely on OA's sister, a student, for help.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Partners in Crime
tntwest.us.description: Maggie and OA must find a couple that is responsible for a spree of violent armed robberies that led to the death of an off-duty police officer.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Double Bind
tntwest.us.description: As the team works to rescue a 5-year-old kidnapping victim, Scola suspects the boy's mother isn't being forthcoming about why her son was targeted; Nina struggles to open up to Scola about matters in their relationship.

tntwest.us.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
tntwest.us.description: The last of five coveted "golden tickets" falls into the hands of a sweet but very poor boy. He and his grandpa then get a tour of the strangest chocolate factory in the world. The owner leads five young winners on a thrilling and often dangerous tour of his factory.

tntwest.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tntwest.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - Renaissance Humanism - 1350 - 1650
truehistory.us.description: A revived interest in the literary and historical works of classical Greece and Rome; new ideas about the qualifications of a gentleman, the role of women and the expectations of a prince; a resulting emphasis on literacy and education.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Rethinking the Persian Empire
truehistory.us.description: Cyrus, Darius and Xerxes; these Persian kings are sometimes stereotyped as one-dimensional despots in Greek histories; the truth about the Achaemenid Persian Empire; an empire that stretches from Egypt and Asia Minor, all the way to the Indus Valley.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Questioning the Sources
truehistory.us.description: Greek historians provide valuable information about the Persian Empire; the Greek perspective is often negatively biased; archaeology uncovers inscriptions, administrative tablets and other documents that let the Persians speak for themselves.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - The World before Cyrus
truehistory.us.description: The ancient world before the Persian Empire; in the centuries leading up to the Persian Empire, the Assyrians are the major international power; the Assyrian kingdom collapses; it leaves a power vacuum in the region; the stage set for new power.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Cyrus and Cambyses - Founders of the Empire
truehistory.us.description: Cyrus, the first great king of the Persian Empire, expands the empire through pragmatic leadership; he uses local customs and traditions and thereby gains legitimacy over Central Asia and Babylon; his son Cambyses expands the empire into Egypt.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Darius I - Creator of the Imperial System
truehistory.us.description: Whether Darius, the son-in-law of Cyrus, is a legitimate king; After Cambyses dies, Darius establishes himself as an unwavering leader; Darius creates a royal genealogy and a Persian identity; he then turns to building infrastructure.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Persian Capitals and Royal Palaces
truehistory.us.description: The five Persian capitals; Pasargadae, Ecbatana, Babylon, Susa and Persepolis; built in strategic, fortified locations, these cities are major symbols of power for the great kings; exploring the great hall at Persepolis, which holds 10,000 guests.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - The Great King - Images and Realities
truehistory.us.description: Seeing beyond the outside stereotypes of Persian kings as tyrants; seeing what the kings themselves have to say; in sculpted reliefs and carvings on royal tombs, the words and images of Darius and Xerxes show Persian values of harmonious cooperation.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Royal Roads and Provinces
truehistory.us.description: A trip into the western provinces; the empire's diverse local customs; the Persian Empire is famous for its roads and bridges; how its express messenger system allows information to travel quickly; the king keeps tabs on every corner of the empire.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Taking On the Other Side of History
truehistory.us.description: The past comes alive when considering the imaginary lives of ordinary people; these include the citizens, soldiers and slaves who live on the other side of history; asking questions that many textbooks never ask.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Being Paleolithic
truehistory.us.description: Taking a look at the lives of human ancestors; picturing oneself as a Neanderthal, whose life is dominated by the environment; discovering the significance of the human mind, language and art in the Old Stone Age.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Living in Mesopotamia
truehistory.us.description: Stepping into the world's earliest permanent settlement; why the development of agriculture is a revolution; the invention of writing; the creation of laws; an increase in trade; technological innovations such as the wheel.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Being Egyptian
truehistory.us.description: What it is like to be an ancient Egyptian; exploring everyday life during the New Kingdom era; the richness of the Nile; the conservatism and stability of the society; relics that survive across millennia, such as hieroglyphics, papyri and art.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Take Me Out at the Ballgame
trutv.us.description: Q, Murr, Joe and Sal get drenched at a water park, and play a wild round of TP basketball at a grocery store; the loser strikes out while jockeying for a ball from New York Mets pitcher Noah Syndergaard.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Party Crasher
trutv.us.description: Joe, Sal, Q and Murr dodge shakedowns with the help of some strangers and then get handsy in a parking lot; a clip bait battle takes place in the park and the loser has a run-in at a party.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Dover and Out
trutv.us.description: Sal, Murr, Joe and Q survey employees with odd questions; tonight's loser unveils a mural in a small town whose residents react with big-city rage.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Marathon Man
trutv.us.description: Sal, Murr, Q and Joe climb to the Top of the Rock for some awkward interactions, then "whet" their appetites at a bagel shop; the evening's loser takes a run across the Brooklyn Bridge that is anything but inspiring.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Guilty as Charged
trutv.us.description: Murr, Sal, Joe, and Q enlist shoppers to help them avoid a rogue security guard; the big loser faces the wrath of a crowd of rockers.

trutvwest.us.title: Miracle
trutvwest.us.description: When college coach Herb Brooks (Kurt Russell) is hired to helm the 1980 U.S. men's Olympic hockey team, he brings a unique and brash style to the ice. After assembling a team of hot-headed college all-stars, who are humiliated in an early match, Brooks unites his squad against a common foe, the heavily-favored Soviet team. As the U.S. squad tries to overcome insurmountable odds and win the gold medal, the team becomes a microcosm for American patriotism during the Cold War.

trutvwest.us.title: Super Bowl XXVIII Champions: The 1993 Dallas Cowboys
trutvwest.us.description: In 1993, the Dallas Cowboys joined the San Francisco 49ers and the Pittsburgh Steelers as the only franchises to win four Super Bowls.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Parent Trap
trutvwest.us.description: Sal, Joe, Murr and Q get stuck in a grocery showdown, beg strangers for questionable quotes, and spew financial tips that are anything but sound; the night's big loser earns a time-out for his outrageous behavior at a kids' play space.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Catastrophe
trutvwest.us.description: Murr, Sal, Q and Joe serve up the goods at a juice bar, and tonight's loser confronts his biggest fear in a punishment that leaves him practically catatonic.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Vampire Weakened
trutvwest.us.description: Sal, Joe, Murr and Q act frosty while working the ice cream counter, taking Joe's dogs for a romp in the park with help from some strangers; the loser watches his blood boil while performing with a gospel choir.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - X Man
trutvwest.us.description: Q, Sal, Murr and Joe compete in a four-way challenge; at a child's art class, a big loser is hit with an on-the-spot punishment.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Medium, Well Done
trutvwest.us.description: Murr, Sal, Q and Joe pose as TV execs pitching insane shows; the night's big loser undergoes a psychic reading that puts his real life on the wrong track.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Drum and Drummer
trutvwest.us.description: Sal, Murr, Q and Joe convince shoppers to repeat odd catchphrases; going mental as psychoanalysts; the evening's losers perform at a halftime show.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers: Inside Jokes - Well...
trutvwest.us.description: Going behind the scenes to find out how the guys create rules for new challenges, which Jokers used to carpool to set, and how the crew set up for a secretive, psychological punishment.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers: Inside Jokes - The Prize Fighter
trutvwest.us.description: How the crew keeps their presence a secret in restaurants; what Murr's go-to dance move is; which Joker used to attend team building seminars; phony fees the Jokers came up with that didn't make the cut.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers: Inside Jokes - Urine Trouble
trutvwest.us.description: What names the Jokers didn't get to in the name game challenge; which of the guys always laughs at a fart joke; who wrote the lyrics for the a cappella group; which Joker has been stung by a jellyfish in real life.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers: Inside Jokes - Irritable Vowel Syndrome
trutvwest.us.description: Going behind the scenes to find out what Q frequently eats for lunch during filming, why Murr hired a personal pastry chef to come to the set, and what animals were a part of the punishment.

trutvwest.us.title: Pain Relief Revealed
trutvwest.us.description: Discover the hidden story of OmegaXL with John Walsh. He dives deep into the groundbreaking supplement that promises hope and relief for millions battling joint pain and inflammation.

trutvwest.us.title: Ready for a safer shower? Enjoy a one-day bath remodel with Jacuzzi.
trutvwest.us.description: Trusted brand Jacuzzi Bath Remodel and interior designer Christina Hall share their secrets on how you can easily and affordably transform your bathroom into a gorgeous custom, safe, stylish space in 1 day! Call for a FREE quote & installation.

trutvwest.us.title: Never Scrub Your Floors Again
trutvwest.us.description: See why this cleaning tool replaces chemicals and hard labor!

trutvwest.us.title: Pain Relief Revealed
trutvwest.us.description: Discover the hidden story of OmegaXL with John Walsh. He dives deep into the groundbreaking supplement that promises hope and relief for millions battling joint pain and inflammation.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Butt of the Joker
trutvwest.us.description: Sal, Q, Joe and Murr pair up in focus group presentations; the night's loser tries to cure the public of a nasty habit - but gets people smoking mad.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Stuffed Turkey
trutvwest.us.description: Q, Sal, Joe and Murr act as not-so-handy-men assembling furniture; Thanksgiving comes early for tonight's loser when he must talk turkey at a dating event.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Crickets
trutvwest.us.description: Murr, Sal, Q and Joe head to Joey Fatone's hot dog joint to dish up weenies; the night's big loser performs a stand-up comedy routine but barely gets out alive.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Mime and Punishment
trutvwest.us.description: Joe, Sal, Murr and Q put the nasty in "namaste" when they lead guided meditations; the big loser gets boxed in with a 24-hour punishment.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Three Men and Your Baby
trutvwest.us.description: Sal, Joe, Murr and Q get snap happy posing as photographers; three Jokers are faced with a punishment that's not child's play.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Q-Pay
trutvwest.us.description: Q, Murr, Sal and Joe kill time in a waiting room by sharing some TMI texts with strangers; they try to sabotage each other at a dating event; the big loser gets a special donation from one of the other Jokers.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Rubbed the Wrong Way
trutvwest.us.description: Joe, Sal, Q and Murr cruise the food court sending texts to strangers, then throw caution (and groceries) to the wind; tonight's loser is cast as a genie in a play.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Flatfoot the Pirate
trutvwest.us.description: Q, Sal, Joe and Murr explain why they've been doused with water at the mall; the big loser plays a pirate but won't find any rum in his cup.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Remember the Pact
trutvwest.us.description: Murr, Sal, Joe and Q beg shoppers to hold on to a weird item and then teach tech to seniors; the loser reveals his embarrassing digital life to his dad.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Silence of the Lame
trutvwest.us.description: The guys square off in a toy-pitching competition; the big loser must quiet down patrons in a food court.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Planet of the Apes
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Complex sociological themes run through this science-fiction classic about three astronauts marooned on a futuristic planet where apes rule and humans are slaves. The stunned trio discovers that these highly intellectual simians can both walk upright and talk. They have even established a class system and a political structure. The astronauts suddenly find themselves part of a devalued species, trapped and imprisoned by the apes.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monkey Business
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Chemist Dr. Barnaby Fulton (Cary Grant) is developing a pill that will defy the aging process for the pharmaceutical company run by Oliver Oxley (Charles Coburn). When a loose chimpanzee mixes chemicals together that produce this effect, Fulton tries some on himself. This prompts him to act like a teenager, making passes at Oxley's buxom secretary, Lois (Marilyn Monroe). Soon everyone, including Fulton's wife, Edwina (Ginger Rogers), is feeling the effects of the formula, with hilarious results.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bedtime for Bonzo
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A professor (Ronald Reagan) hires a nanny (Diana Lynn) to help him raise a chimp, hoping to decide nature vs. nurture.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Every Which Way But Loose
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A tough trucker with a cheeky pet orangutan, Philo Beddoe (Clint Eastwood) moonlights as a fighter, with his close friend Orville Boggs (Geoffrey Lewis) setting up matches for him. When Philo begins dating country singer Lynn Halsey-Taylor (Sondra Locke), and she abruptly disappears, he goes off in search of her, his simian companion and Orville in tow. On their cross-country trek, Philo and friends repeatedly clash with bikers, leading up to a violent showdown.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Royal Wedding
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: American sibling song-and-dance team Tom (Fred Astaire) and Ellen Bowen (Jane Powell) are in London in 1947, when all of England is in a tizzy over the impending nuptials of Princess Elizabeth and Prince Philip. Ellen falls head over heels for the dashing Lord John Brindale (Peter Lawford), and Tom becomes equally smitten with the elegant Anne Ashmond (Sarah Churchill). The film features one of Astaire's most legendary dance performances, dancing across the ceiling of a hotel room.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Singin' in the Rain
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A spoof of the turmoil that afflicted the movie industry in the late 1920s when movies went from silent to sound. When two silent movie stars', Don Lockwood and Lina Lamont, latest movie is made into a musical a chorus girl is brought in to dub Lina's speaking and singing. Don is on top of the world until Lina finds out.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Brigadoon
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tommy Albright (Gene Kelly) and Jeff Douglas (Van Johnson), two American pals on a Scottish hunting trip, get lost in the woods and come upon the magical village of Brigadoon. Rising out of the Scottish mist only once every 100 years, and only for one day, Brigadoon is an enchanted place where life is simpler and easier, untouched by the worries of the modern world. When Tommy falls for beautiful villager Fiona Campbell (Cyd Charisse), he must decide whether to stay or to return to his life.

tvasports.ca.title: Canada in the Rough

wanedt.us.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
wanedt.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wanedt.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wanedt.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wanedt.us.description: Get ready for all of Sunday's game action on CBS with "The NFL Today." Hosted by James Brown, the hourlong show presents a mix of features, highlights, predictions and the latest news from across the league. wbng.us.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
wbng.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wbng.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wbng.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wbng.us.title: The NFL Today
wbng.us.description: Get ready for all of Sunday's game action on CBS with "The NFL Today." Hosted by James Brown, the hourlong show presents a mix of features, highlights, predictions and the latest news from across the league. Analysts alongside Brown include Nate Burleson, Bill Cowher, Russell Wilson and Kyle Long.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wcsc.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wcsc.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wctv.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wctv.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wctv.us.title: The NFL Today
wctv.us.description: Get ready for all of Sunday's game action on CBS with "The NFL Today." Hosted by James Brown, the hourlong show presents a mix of features, highlights, predictions and the latest news from across the league.
